archaeology_roll_header:
Breakthrough Chance
This reflects the chance of your Scientist making a breakthrough during the excavation of the current site.

Every time a phase ends, a die (1 to 10) is rolled. The result of the roll is added to Skill Bonus and Clues, then subtracted by Difficulty.

The current score before dice roll is $SCORE|0Y$.

planet_museum_exhibits_desc: The display of alien artifacts reinvigorates our museum exhibits.
planet_manager_awards_desc: Executives and Managers on this planet are competing to maximize business synergies and exceed key performance indicator goals.

edict_zro_crystal_desc: The properties of Zro are mysterious. Yet if given to our leaders, it seems they obtain slight precognitive abilities, allowing them to learn faster and avoid dangers that could have ended their lives early.
edict_zro_crystal_machine_desc: The properties of Zro are mysterious. Yet if sprinkled on our leader's motherboards, it seems to grant them slight precognitive abilities, allowing them to learn faster and avoid dangers that could have ended their existence.

planet_destruction.901.name: Planet Devolved
planet_destruction.901.desc: As the energies of the mind wiping beam from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipate, [From.GetName]'s population has almost entirely regressed to the pre-sapient stage. Those who were spared can now only watch in horror as those they once knew return to animalistic behaviors.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLOSSUS_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Colossus
Larger than even a Titan, the Colossus hull configuration has no ship-to-ship combat capability. It is more of a mobile orbital station, capable only of complete planetary devastation.
MEGASTRUCTURE_BUILD_OUTSIDE_GRAVITY_WELL: Cannot build this megastructure within the gravity well of a system
MEGASTRUCTURE_BUILD_CANNOT_MOVE_TO_TARGE: Cannot build this megastructure in an unreachable system
planet_destruction.101.name: World Cracked
planet_destruction.102.name: Cracking Open a Cold One
planet_destruction.101.desc:
The [From.From.GetName]'s gentle rocking - buffeted by [From.GetName]'s rupturing crust and unraveling magnetosphere - subsides as the Colossus completes its cataclysmic task.

The sheer violence of a dying planet is difficult to comprehend, but the funereal beauty of [From.GetName]'s molten core cooling in gelid space is undeniable.
planet_destruction.301.name: Neutron Swept
planet_destruction.301.nobots.desc:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface. Scans report no signs of sapient life; plant life, while damaged, may recover in time. Some would call the total annihilation of intelligent life, while preserving inanimate matter, a perverse war crime.

We would call it efficient.
planet_destruction.301.bots.desc:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface.

Sonic sensors relay nothing but the wind and the gentle clicks and whirrs of the surviving synthetic populace. All sapient organic life has been wiped out.
planet_destruction.301.infested.desc:
The [From.From.GetName]'s neutron plume peters out, having finished its sweep of [From.GetName]'s surface.

A quick scan confirms that the infested landscape, previously a roiling and writhing mass of organic activity, is now bereft of all life. Only barren rock remains.
planet_destruction.401.name: Faith Enforced
planet_destruction.401.desc:
The empyreal hum of the [From.From.GetName]'s psionic coils fades, and for a moment all is quiet. Down on [From.GetName] the people stand slack-jawed (or local physiognomic equivalent), enraptured by the powerful and personal truths the psionic ray unfetters from the tangled web of their minds.

If they did not understand before, they know now viscerally: we are all part of something greater.
planet_destruction.401.tooltip:
Any Mechanical, Machine, or Hive-Minded £ Pops are destroyed by the psionic resonance.

All remaining £ Biological Pops become Spiritualist.

Adds the Divine Light modifier to [This.GetName] for 10 years:
Spiritualist Ethics Attraction: +999%.
planet_destruction.501.name: Nanobots Dispersed
planet_destruction.501.desc:
The [From.From.GetName] has completed deployment of the assimilation nanobot payload, calculated to be sufficient to cybernetically dominate all sapient organics on [From.GetName].

We did not build the [From.From.GetName] with any sensors or instruments to measure our success, but we know. We open our eyes for the first time down on [From.GetName]. We see ourselves and are seen by ourselves.

On [From.GetName]'s surface, there is only us.
planet_destruction.501.tooltip: All £ Organic Pops gain the Cybernetic trait.
planet_destruction.701.name: Planet Drenched
planet_destruction.701.desc: As the column of water descending from the [FromFrom.GetName] dissipates, the surface of [From.GetName] is wholly transformed. Where once there were sprawling continents bereft of water, now there is only the welcoming shimmer of pristine, blue ocean ready to be inhabited.
planet_destruction.701.tooltip:
The planet becomes an Class O (Pelagic).
All Pops lacking the Aquatic trait die.
planet_destruction.801.name: Planet Toxified
planet_destruction.801.desc: As the awesome stream of venomous substances from the [FromFrom.GetName] subsides, [From.GetName] is transformed from a vibrant ecosystem to a noxious world on which few forms of life can thrive.
planet_destruction.610.name: [outraged_FE.GetName]
planet_destruction.610.desc:
[From.GetName] was a holy world.


You do not know the true extent of your sin.


Not yet.
planet_destruction.610.mater: It was just a planetary body.
planet_destruction.610.autho: That was yours? Well, not anymore.
planet_destruction.610.phobe: Nothing you hold sacred shall remain.
planet_destruction.610.gesta: What is but a single world?
planet_destruction.610.termi: Erased, like so much junk data.
planet_destruction.610.purif: Old heresies will do naught but burn.
planet_destruction.615.spir: Consider it as sprinkling the holy water.
planet_destruction.111.name: Hyperspace Bypass
planet_destruction.111.desc: The Hyperspace Planning Council reports that the removal of the third planet in Sol from the system's gravity well has allowed a natural wormhole to form. This wormhole may eventually reduce FTL traffic congestion in the nearby hyperlanes.
planet_destruction.111.a: Apathetic bloody planet, I've no sympathy at all.
planet_destruction.210.name: [From.GetName] Shielded
planet_destruction.210.desc:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Perhaps history will call the shielding, this complete severing of [From.GetName] from the greater cosmos, extreme and unjustified. Or perhaps not. For now, the [From.GetStarName] system has a new planetary terrarium.
planet_destruction.210.desc.alt:
The glittering beam from the [From.From.GetName] fades, and [From.GetName] is silent.

Life goes on, if contained.
planet_destruction.210.a: Tap on the glass and watch them squirm.
origin_here_be_dragons_desc: Since time immemorial, this civilization has shared its star system with a formidable dragon. The mysterious creature's behavior sways between distant benevolence and haughty indifference. How this relationship will evolve as the planet dwellers take to the stars remains to be seen.
origin_ocean_paradise_desc: Since its birth, this civilization has enjoyed peace in a generous environment with no natural enemies, enabling unhindered growth and opulence.

job_angler_desc: Hook and line are things of the past, but sustainably growing and hauling food out of nature takes equal patience, much planning, and great care.
job_pearl_diver_desc: Concerning cultivation and farming more than diving, these specialists still bring back a large variety of treasures from the depths.
job_pearl_diver_effect_desc: [artisan.GetIcon] [artisan.GetNamePlural] turn £ Food and £ Minerals into £ Supplies and £ Trade
job_pearl_crafter_desc: Skilled and creative crafters, these specialists manufacture a variety of luxury goods from treasures brought back from the depths.
job_pearl_crafter_effect_desc: £ Pearl Divers turn £ Food and £ Minerals into £ Supplies and £ Trade
edict_astral_binding_desc: We have learned how to weave Astral Thread into any other material in the universe. It is the very fabric of dimension.
edict_astral_binding_effects: Increase all other material resource gains by 10%.
edict_astral_shielding_desc: There is no stronger barrier than a tightly knit lattice of Astral Threads.
edict_dimensional_artificing_desc: Manifesting objects of cultural significance from other dimensions can be done under the right circumstances. Whether or not our actions will be noticed in the other planes, we cannot say.

origin_riftworld_desc: A massive rift in space and time looms near this civilization's homeworld. After studying the phenomenon for millennia, recent advances in starship technology will allow them to finally reach out and discover what secrets it might hold.
origin_tooltip_riftworld_effects:

edict_shadow_matrix_desc: The electronic obscurity provided by dark matter processing units generates software that even the best codebreakers must struggle with.
edict_obsidian_veil_desc: To hide in a forest, one should wear the earth. To hide in space, one should wear the void.
edict_dark_matter_forging_desc: The unique binding properties of dark matter as a flux in our foundries increases the yield by appreciable amounts.
edict_dark_matter_unravelling_desc: The energy contained within bonds formed by dark matter can be unraveled into a valuable output.
edict_inner_focus_desc: Overextension of one's boundaries introduces a variety of risks. Understanding oneself is a more reliable and productive endeavor.
edict_baryonic_insight_desc: For a deeper understanding of the weave of the universe, we must look beyond the notion of the atom.
anomaly_astral_scar_desc:
We have discovered an anomalous rift in space and time. The closer we get, the less the known laws of physical relativity hold purchase.

Studying this phenomenon could very well push our scientific understanding of the mechanics of the universe to a higher level.
anomaly_greatest_show_desc:
A brightly lit object has been detected on an asteroid in [from.System.GetName].

Constructed of highly advanced materials, it is broadcasting a steady stream of radio waves on all frequencies. Our scanners indicate no explosive or volatile compounds contained within. It seems safe to approach and study further.
anomaly_black_hole_instable_desc: Our scanners have detected significant deviations from the expected physical properties of the black hole in the [from.System.GetName] system. Its gravitational forces are unpredictable, resulting in noticeable temporal inconsistencies from one point in space to another.
anomaly_spontaneous_explosions_desc: We have detected spontaneous explosions on the surface of [this.GetName]. With no orbiting warships or detectable surface life, the cause of these massive blasts remains unknown.
job_munitions_decommissioner_desc: These practical researchers inspect and reverse-engineer ancient weapons to fit our modern specifications.
job_munitions_decommissioning_unit_desc: Specialized units for the disassembly and analysis of ancient weapons.
job_munitions_decommissioning_drone_desc: These drones efficiently disassemble ancient weapons to fit our modern specifications.
job_astral_researcher_desc: The strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension, including our own. These researchers work tirelessly to decipher their significance while minimizing paradoxes.
job_astral_researcher_effect_desc: £ Astral Researchers turn £ Supplies into £ £ £ Research and £ Astral Threads
job_astral_drone_desc: The strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension, including our own. These drones are tasked with deciphering their significance while minimizing paradoxes.
job_astral_drone_effect_desc: £ Astral Drones turn £ Minerals into £ £ £ Research and £ Astral Threads
job_astral_unit_desc: The strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension, including our own. These units attempt to decipher their significance while avoiding paradoxes at all costs.
job_astral_unit_effect_desc: £ Astral Units turn £ Energy Credits into £ £ £ Research and £ Astral Threads
edict_automated_disinfection_desc: The cleaning drones we discovered in one of our visits beyond an Astral Rift have enlightened us on more efficient methods of sanitation involving fleets of autonomous robots.
edict_spontaneous_crystallization_desc: By applying a unique matrix of catalysts onto freshly harvested rock, we have a chance at generating much more valuable crystalline structures.
edict_spontaneous_crystallization_toolti: Convert up to 1% of total £ Mineral income into £ Rare Crystals.
edict_astral_cloaking_desc: Astral threads used in cloaking field generators partially 'reflect' our ships into other dimensions, making them even more difficult to detect in this one.
TECH_UNLOCK_mauler_stage_1_CONSTRUCTION_:
Juvenile Mauler
The Mauler is the most basic military ship, armed with close range weapons and thick carapace armor.
TECH_UNLOCK_mauler_stage_2_CONSTRUCTION_:

A Mature Mauler has been selectively grown to support greater firepower and armor.

TECH_UNLOCK_weaver_stage_1_CONSTRUCTION_:
Juvenile Weaver
The Weaver is a versatile mid-sized bioship, designed to outmaneuver larger foes and support fleet engagements.
TECH_UNLOCK_weaver_stage_2_CONSTRUCTION_:
Mature Weaver
A Mature Weaver has been selectively grown to enhance mobility and adaptability in fleet operations.
TECH_UNLOCK_weaver_stage_3_CONSTRUCTION_:
Elder Weaver
An Elder Weaver has been meticulously grown for superior agility and tactical versatility.
TECH_UNLOCK_harbinger_stage_1_CONSTRUCTI:
Juvenile Harbinger
The Harbinger bolsters the fleet by spawning strike craft.
TECH_UNLOCK_harbinger_stage_2_CONSTRUCTI:
Mature Harbinger
Enhanced growth techniques yield stronger and more reliable vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_harbinger_stage_3_CONSTRUCTI:
Elder Harbinger
Grown for maximum strength and battlefield superiority.
TECH_UNLOCK_stinger_stage_1_CONSTRUCTION:
Juvenile Stinger
A swift and deadly bioship, bred for precision strikes and tactical superiority."
TECH_UNLOCK_stinger_stage_2_CONSTRUCTION:
Mature Stinger
Refined for greater speed and precision in tactical operations.
TECH_UNLOCK_stinger_stage_3_CONSTRUCTION:
Elder Stinger
Grown for ultimate speed, precision, and battlefield dominance.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_FISSION_POWER_DESC:
Fission Metabolism
With proper bio-engineering, a digestive tract can act as a biological nuclear reactor allowing for a metabolism based on induced fission, producing both power and harmful nuclear waste
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_FUSION_POWER_DESC:
Fusion Metabolism
By integrating microfauna capable of nuclear fusion into the biome of a bioship's gut, this system generates immense power while avoiding many of the hazards associated with fission-based energy sources.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_COLD_FUSION_POWER_DESC:
Cold Fusion Metabolism
The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_ANTIMATTER_POWER_DESC:
Antimatter Metabolism
By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_ZERO_POINT_POWER_DESC:
Zero Point Metabolism
These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_DARK_MATTER_POWER_DESC:
Dark Matter Metabolism
A mysterious substance coats the digestive tract of our biological ships, drawing energy directly from dark matter in an apparent violation of known physical laws.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_SENSOR_2_DESC:
Gravitic Sensors
These sensory organs have been developed to detect gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_SENSOR_3_DESC:
Subspace Sensors
Sensory organs that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range far exceeds any previous sensory organ developed for deep space.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_SENSOR_4_DESC:
Tachyon Sensors
Sensory organs that make use of rotating tachyon beams to detect interstellar movement at extreme distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_HYPERDRIVE_2_DESC:
Bio-Hyperlane Field II
We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_HYPERDRIVE_3_DESC:
Bio-Hyperlane Field III
A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing the subspace slipstreams that are present within hyperspace. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIO_PSI_JUMPDRIVE_1_DESC:
Psionic Jump Organ
The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_1_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Chemical Stellar Motor Organs
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_1_DESC:
Chemical Stellar Motor Organs
Through a combination of muscles, fins, and chemical exhausts this ship is capable of sublight travel.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Ion Stellar Motor Organs
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_2_DESC:
Ion Stellar Motor Organs
An array of electrically charged organs accelerate ions to generate thrust.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Plasma Stellar Motor Organs
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_3_DESC:
Plasma Stellar Motor Organs
Further refinements of the electrical capabilities of the motor organs allow for greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Impulse Stellar Motor Organs
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_4_DESC:
Impulse Stellar Motor Organs
Highly advanced fusion chambers grant this ship unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Dark Matter Stellar Motor Organs
TECH_UNLOCK_BIOSHIP_THRUSTER_5_DESC:
Dark Matter Stellar Motor Organs
Embedded clusters of dark matter within the ship's tissues enable it to "swim" through space, moving in ways that defy conventional physics and our current understanding of propulsion.
TECH_UNLOCK_ADVANCED_GROWTH_CHAMBER_DESC: Growth Chambers now provide +2 Shipyard Capacity.
origin_evolutionary_predators_desc:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_mutation_ascension'].

This species has always hunted the most unique creatures, driven by an instinct they didn't fully understand. Possessing a rare ability to integrate the genetics of their prey, it evolved into the apex predator of its world, absorbing every genetic advantage available. Now, their hunger leads them to the stars.

TECH_UNLOCK_COSMO_MAULER_CONSTRUCTION_DE:
Cipher Mauler
Through organic spacetime-dimensional transcendentalism, this Mauler is larger on the inside its compact frame concealing a dense tangle of musculature. Capable of a bite deadlier than physics should allow.
TECH_UNLOCK_COSMO_WEAVER_CONSTRUCTION_DE:
Matrix Weaver
Equipped with support weapon arrays that outstrip its visible anatomy, the Quandary Weaver rewrites spatial norms. Alone, it can shift the momentum of entire battles.
TECH_UNLOCK_COSMO_HARBINGER_CONSTRUCTION:
Maze Harbinger
These Harbingers nest their strike craft in interwoven pocket dimensions, each ship a labyrinth of impossible hangars, capable of deploying a fleet's worth of firepower.
TECH_UNLOCK_COSMO_STINGER_CONSTRUCTION_D:
Cryptic Stinger
Brimming with more weapon systems than its power source should sustain, this Stinger shouldn't function, and yet, it fires. Continuously.

planet_building_buffer_desc: Although growing the mind spires to commune with the Beast is a fast process, we had to plan contingencies to ensure the continued support of the planet's infrastructure.
job_transference_volunteer_desc: For many, the mindlink with the Beast is but an afterthought. Constant, but remote. For some however, the need to merge with it is irrepressible. These volunteers act as a conduit as their minds are slowly absorbed into the beastly collective.
job_transference_volunteer_effect_desc:
£ [GetTransferenceVolunteerDrone] produce £ Unity, increase planet £ Stability and make our Ships stronger.
10% of Pops working this job will get Transferred every 6 months. Killing them, but multiplying the District's resource output.

Pops Transferred: [num_tranferred_pops]
job_transference_drone_desc: While the mindlink established a permanent connection between the Beast and us, the transference is a slow process. Without these precautions we risk shattering both psyches and ruin everything.

edict_behemoth_living_metal_augmentation: Layering living metal between chitin layers creates reactive armor with enhanced ablative properties.

job_augmentation_merchant_desc: Who could possibly guide our empire but the ones who offer self-improvement at such an affordable cost and with an extended warranty on top.
job_visionary_desc: Unfettered by precedent and unburdened by humility, these dreamers of tomorrow transmute bold speculation into marketable reality. To a true visionary, progress is not merely a principle; it is a product.
job_noble_merchant_desc: The right to rule is determined not by inheritance, but by the measure of one's worth; and how better to measure your worth than by the sum total of the balance sheet?

origin_asteroid_category_desc: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.
ship_gasgiant_category_desc: The sensor profile of a mid-sized vessel was briefly detected inside the upper atmosphere of this gas giant.
anomaly_failure.1.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] ordered the [Root.GetName] to dispatch a probe to investigate the crater on [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, its braking thrusters failed and the probe proceeded to smash right into the wrecked ship at the center of the crater.
anomaly_failure.2.desc: Although asteroid [From.From.GetName] may be an extrasolar capture, it is completely unremarkable in every other sense. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and the crew of the [Root.GetName] have asked for permission to continue their mission of exploration elsewhere.
anomaly_failure.3.desc: The entire crew of the [Root.GetName] spent days arduously sifting through the debris on the surface of [From.From.GetName] in rotating shifts. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that nothing of value was found.
anomaly_failure.4.desc: No source of the strange energy emissions coming from asteroid [From.From.GetName] was ever found. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and the [Root.GetName] are awaiting new orders.
anomaly_failure.5.desc: While attempting to open the docking hatch we found on [From.From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] accidentally caused a tremor inside the asteroid. Unfortunately, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has deduced that this likely led to the destruction of the asteroid's interior.
anomaly_failure.6.desc: The investigation of the massive surface crater on asteroid [From.From.GetName] has yielded nothing of interest. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has ordered the [Root.GetName] to discontinue the mission.
anomaly_failure.7.desc: The [Root.GetName] made a failed attempt to dock with the space station orbiting [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, the fragile station disintegrated as a result. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] begs forgiveness.
anomaly_failure.7.desc.mach: The [Root.GetName] made a failed attempt to dock with the space station orbiting [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, the fragile station disintegrated as a result. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that an unfortunate software glitch concerning trajectory calculations was to blame.
anomaly_failure.8.desc: The source of the life signs that were reported on asteroid [From.From.GetName], if indeed there ever was one, has not been found despite repeated scans by the [Root.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has requested new orders.
anomaly_failure.9.desc: If there truly is an object somewhere beneath the atmosphere of [From.From.GetName], it lies far too deep to be detected by the sensors of the [Root.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has abandoned the search.
anomaly_failure.10.desc: After an extensive survey of the small moonlet circling [From.From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] found nothing of worth. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has terminated the mission.
anomaly_failure.11.desc: Acting on orders from Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], the [Root.GetName] sent a probe into the atmosphere of [From.From.GetName] to investigate the life signs that had been reported. The presence of a rich atmospheric ecosystem was discovered, but 3.4 seconds later the probe contaminated the atmosphere and triggered a chemical chain-reaction that spread rapidly across the entire gas giant. No signs of life can be detected now.
anomaly_failure.12.desc: Nothing particularly interesting has been discovered about the atmosphere of [From.From.GetName], despite an extensive analysis that included a brief trip into the gas giant's upper atmosphere by the [Root.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has recommended an end to the mission.
anomaly_failure.13.desc: As the [Root.GetName] approached the aerostat structures in the atmosphere of [From.From.GetName], the ship must have triggered some kind of proximity alarm. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the structures suddenly lost all buoyancy and plummeted into the gas giant's lower atmosphere.
anomaly_failure.14.desc: The [Root.GetName] inadvertently bumped into the cargo pod orbiting [From.From.GetName] while trying to collect it. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the collision sent the pod deep into the gas giant's atmosphere, from where it can no longer be retrieved.
anomaly_failure.15.desc: The debris field that surrounds [From.From.GetName] has been thoroughly scanned by the [Root.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports no significant findings.
anomaly_failure.16.desc: Despite a thorough investigation, the [Root.GetName] has still not been able to deduce what caused the massive impact crater on [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] apologizes for this failure.
anomaly_failure.16.desc.mach: Despite a thorough investigation, the [Root.GetName] has still not been able to deduce what caused the massive impact crater on [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has logged the failure as due to insufficient residue remaining on the surface of the moon.
anomaly_failure.17.desc: If there were anomalous energy readings coming from [From.From.GetName], they appear to be gone now. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [Root.GetName] has detected nothing of the sort.
anomaly_failure.18.desc: There WAS some sort of unidentified object in orbit around [From.From.GetName], but the [Root.GetName] accidentally collided with it when moving closer to investigate. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the object, regrettably, was destroyed in the collision.
anomaly_failure.19.desc: No distinguishing features were found on the small asteroid that had seemingly been towed into orbit around [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is requesting new orders for the [Root.GetName].
anomaly_failure.20.desc: Sadly, the solar sailer found above [From.From.GetName] was destroyed in a clumsy attempt by Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] to bring it into the cargo bay of the [Root.GetName].
anomaly_failure.21.desc: The initial survey report, which mentioned life signs originating from the surface of [From.From.GetName], must have been mistaken, as nothing of the sort has been found by the [Root.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] now appears to be completely devoid of life.
anomaly_failure.22.desc: What was thought to have been a hidden orbital station above [From.From.GetName] has been identified as garbage ejected by the very Science Ship that conducted the initial survey of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and the crew of the [Root.GetName] suggest that we forget about this embarrassing episode and move on.
anomaly_failure.23.desc: After careful analysis, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has determined that the ship debris found above [From.From.GetName] originated from a single garbage scow. [Root.GetName] collected some of the debris, but it appears to be completely worthless.
anomaly_failure.24.desc: Deep scans from the [Root.GetName] seem to have triggered some kind of cascading power failure in the ancient shipyard orbiting [From.From.GetName]. It blew up in a spectacular explosion, according to Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName].
anomaly_failure.25.desc: The "city ruins" that were reported on the surface of [From.From.GetName] turned out to be nothing but unusually shaped rock formations. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] apologizes for this waste of resources, and has requested a new mission for the [Root.GetName].
anomaly_failure.26.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has reported that the origin of the scarring that was observed on the surface of [From.From.GetName] turned out to be natural after all. The [Root.GetName] needs a new assignment.
anomaly_failure.27.desc: The [Root.GetName] lost the weak signal that was coming from [From.From.GetName], and despite the best efforts of Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName], all attempts to track it down again have met with failure.
anomaly_failure.28.desc: The "unnatural" mountain formation that was found on [From.From.GetName] turned out to be quite natural after all. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] feels that it would be an unfortunate waste of resources for the [Root.GetName] to remain here even a second longer.
anomaly_failure.29.desc: Despite repeated attempts, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] and the rest of the crew of the [Root.GetName] were unable to locate the reflecting object that was reported in the initial survey of [From.From.GetName]. Perhaps it was just a sensor glitch.
anomaly_failure.30.desc: The [Root.GetName] was unable to locate the source of the faint transmission we detected coming from the interior of [From.From.GetName]. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the transmission has since ceased completely.
anomaly_failure.31.desc: Despite repeated scans by the [Root.GetName], no hint of the vessel that was supposedly hidden within the atmosphere of [From.From.GetName] has been found. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has expressed doubt that it ever existed.
anomaly_failure.32.desc: After recalculating the orbit of the moon that was supposedly on a collision course with [From.From.GetName], Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has arrived at the conclusion that it will simply be a near miss. The [Root.GetName] should be redeployed to deal with more pressing matters.
anomaly_failure.33.desc: The signs of Vultaum activity in the vicinity of [From.From.GetName] turned out to be false leads. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has asked to continue the search with the [Root.GetName] elsewhere.
anomaly_failure.34.desc: The signs of Yuht activity in the vicinity of [From.From.GetName] turned out to be false leads. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has asked to continue the search with the [Root.GetName] elsewhere.
anomaly_failure.35.desc: The signs of First League activity in the vicinity of [From.From.GetName] turned out to be false leads. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has asked to continue the search with the [Root.GetName] elsewhere.
anomaly_failure.36.desc: The signs of Irassian activity in the vicinity of [From.From.GetName] turned out to be false leads. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has asked to continue the search with the [Root.GetName] elsewhere.
anomaly_failure.37.desc: The signs of Cybrex activity in the vicinity of [From.From.GetName] turned out to be false leads. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has asked to continue the search with the [Root.GetName] elsewhere.
anomaly_failure.400.desc:
For unclear reasons, the resident Science Officer decided to take out a shuttle from the [Root.GetName] to personally investigate asteroid [From.From.GetName]. An explosion was detected shortly afterwards when the shuttle accidentally impacted the asteroid's surface.

A Board of Inquiry later determined that the late scientist had not been trained to operate a class-D shuttlecraft.
anomaly_failure.401.desc:
While maneuvering to investigate [From.From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] accidentally collided with another asteroid. The ship careened out of control until it impacted on the surface of [From.From.GetName], plowing deep into the asteroid's crust.

The Science Officer on board was reported lost along with the rest of the crew.
anomaly_failure.402.desc:
While maneuvering to investigate [From.From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] accidentally collided with another asteroid. The ship careened out of control until it impacted on the surface of [From.From.GetName], plowing deep into the asteroid's crust.

A small group of survivors, including the ship's Science Officer, managed to escape the doomed vessel in an escape pod.
anomaly_failure.403.desc: This asteroid serves as a nesting ground for some kind of large vacuum-based life form! Several of them sally forth from their tunnel network to aggressively defend their territory from the [Root.GetName].
anomaly_failure.404.desc: Several dormant military-grade drones designed by some long lost civilization sit clustered together in a small crater on the far side of [From.From.GetName]. As the [Root.GetName] comes within range of their passive sensors, the drones power up in an effort to fulfill their ancient programming directive - defend the system from intruders at all costs.
anomaly_failure.405.desc: Active scans from the [Root.GetName] briefly picked up several structures on the surface of [From.From.GetName], only to have the signal drowned out by jamming interference seconds later. Several pirate ships have darted out of a hidden hangar on the asteroid and are now approaching in attack formation!
anomaly_failure.900.desc: Tragic news from [From.From.GetName]. The Science Officer in charge was killed by an electrical discharge while traveling inside the gas giant's upper atmosphere in a small shuttlecraft. The crew of the [Root.GetName] have aborted their mission.
anomaly_failure.901.desc: We are still trying to piece together the details, but for some reason it looks like the Science Officer ordered the [Root.GetName] into the upper atmosphere of [From.From.GetName] to investigate a sensor anomaly. Once there the stress to the vessel's hull eventually became too great, and it was lost with all hands.
anomaly_failure.902.desc: While conducting deep scans of [From.From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] suffered a reactor failure and became trapped inside the gas giant's gravity well. The vessel's Science Officer successfully oversaw the evacuation of the entire crew, but the ship itself was pulled into the planet's dense atmosphere never to be seen again.
anomaly_failure.903.desc: While approaching [From.From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] stumbled upon two unknown vessels hiding in the gas giant's sensor shadow. They appear to be smugglers partaking in some kind of clandestine meeting. As soon as they spotted your ship, the smuggler ships disconnected from each other and powered up their weapons. They seem intent on not leaving any witnesses!
anomaly_failure.1400.desc: During operations above [From.From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] suffered a containment breach in its reactor core. The safety of the entire ship was put into jeopardy, but thanks to a valiant act of sacrifice by the vessel's Science Officer the engine room was successfully purged of radiation. Unfortunately, the scientist received a lethal dose of radiation poisoning and could not be saved.
anomaly_failure.1400.desc.mach: During operations above [From.From.GetName], the [Root.GetName] suffered a containment breach in its reactor core. As the safety of the entire ship was put into jeopardy, the vessel's Science Officer made the logical conclusion to sacrifice itself in order to purge the engine room of radiation, based on pre-programmed casualty weighting. In the process, [Root.GetLeaderName] received a dose of radiation large enough to result in semiconductor ionization and silicon lattice displacement damage, rendering them permanently inoperable. The ship and remaining crew, however, were saved.
anomaly_failure.1401.desc: While rerouting power to its main sensor array, the [Root.GetName] experienced a critical reactor failure above [From.From.GetName]. The vessel's Science Officer perished in the resulting explosion, along with the rest of the crew.
anomaly_failure.1402.desc: We are uncertain exactly how it happened, but somehow the ship's Science Officer inadvertently triggered the self-destruct sequence on the [Root.GetName] while running a simulation related to [From.From.GetName] on the ship's onboard computer. All attempts to abort the sequence met with failure, and the entire crew was forced to evacuate before the ship was destroyed.
anomaly_failure.1403.desc: Several pirate ships suddenly launch from where they had been hidden on the surface of [From.From.GetName]. It appears that the [Root.GetName] has stumbled upon a pirate anchorage, and the cutthroats are none too pleased at this intrusion!
anomaly_failure.1404.desc: The orbital space over [From.From.GetName] is apparently used as some sort of mating ground by a large and aggressive species of spacefaring creatures. Angry at being disturbed by the [Root.GetName] in the middle of their coupling, two of the creatures set off to deal with the unwelcome intruder.
anomaly_failure.1405.desc: A small squadron of ancient combat drones appears to have been abandoned in orbit of [From.From.GetName] after some long forgotten battle. As the active sensors of the [Root.GetName] sweep over them, the drones power up and enter attack mode!
anomaly_failure.2500.desc: On closer inspection, the asteroid [From.From.GetName] is found to be silent. One of [Root.GetLeaderName]'s assistants eventually confesses that they may have misread the instruments.
anomaly_failure.2501.desc: The [Root.GetName] struggles to safely navigate the dense debris field surrounding [From.From.GetName]. Whatever their sensors picked up on is gone by the time [Root.GetLeaderName] and crew arrive.
anomaly_failure.2502.desc: The [Root.GetName]'s probes find over the course of their many sweeps over [From.From.GetName]'s surface. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has issued a formal apology for wasting time and resources on a detailed, fruitless, survey of the planet.
anomaly_failure.2503.desc: What appeared from space to be impressive structures are, up close, somewhat disappointing. The [Root.GetName] remained in orbit around [From.GetName] for a time to study the planet's weather patterns, after which Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] was able to confirm that the planetary structures are the result of mundane meteorological factors and not the efforts of intelligent life.
anomaly_failure.2504.desc: Before the crew of the [Root.GetName] could decisively triangulate the distress signal from the super-heated surface of [From.From.GetName], it disappeared. Without a specific geographic point to focus on, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] deems a rescue attempt too dangerous to pursue.
anomaly_failure.2535.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] of the [Root.GetName] reports that the structures on the surface of [From.From.GetName] are utterly beneath our notice and their time is better spent elsewhere.
anomaly_failure.2540.desc:
The crew of the [Root.GetName] report that the asteroid, carved into the likeness of some sort of temple, is indeed pretty.

That is all.
anomaly_failure.2545.desc:
[Root.GetLeaderName]'s crew aboard the [Root.GetName] have determined that the unique aural features of [From.From.GetName] are due to the wildlife on the planet coming together in a capella renditions of unknown, alien songs.

They did not see fit to investigate the matter further.
anomaly_failure.2550.desc: The [Root.GetName] was unable to recover any samples of interest from the ice giant [From.From.GetName].
anomaly_failure.2555.desc: The [Root.GetName]'s exploratory probe uncover a fairly slapdash configuration of alien technology. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s ill-advised attempts to activate the thing unfortunately lead to its destruction.
anomaly_failure.2560.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has issued a report indicating that they are none too pleased having been ordered to study [From.From.GetName], where they have found nothing of interest.
anomaly_failure.2600.desc:
The [Root.GetName] had been orbiting [From.GetName] for some time, monitoring its emanations without incident, when Science Officer [Root.GetName] decided to suit up and spacewalk on the asteroid and procure some mineral samples.

As they touched down on its surface, [From.From.GetName]'s radio-like transmissions suddenly and drastically started increasing in intensity. The microwaves boiled [Root.GetLeaderName] alive within minutes.
anomaly_failure.2601.desc:
We lost track of the [Root.GetName] shortly after it entered the dense field of debris surrounding [From.From.GetName].

Days later, we recovered an escape pod from the edge of the field; Science Officer [Root.GetName] survived, but has no memory of what became of the [Root.GetName] or her crew.
anomaly_failure.2602.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName]'s careless probing of [From.GetName] has angered the two massive Tiyanki that orbit the planet. These creatures pose a substantial threat to the [Root.GetName].
anomaly_failure.2603.desc: The curious formations on [From.From.GetName] are an ancient trap. Before the [Root.GetName] was able to land, the ship was set upon by a small number of old combat drones.
anomaly_failure.2604.desc:
The [Root.GetName] was struck by a sudden eruption of magma from the surface of [From.From.GetName] as it was flying low, trying to get a lock on the distress signal.

There were no survivors.
anomaly_failure.2635.desc:
The point of interest on [From.From.GetName] was once, according to reports from the [Root.GetName], some sort of area dedicated to recreation and amusement. Its age is uncertain, as is the reason why it was established on [From.From.GetName] in the first place.

The crew of the [Root.GetName] also report the regrettable passing of their Science Officer, who was crushed by a toppling structure identified only as a "Ferris wheel."
anomaly_failure.2640.desc:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] remains adamant that the crew of the [Root.GetName] found nothing within the ornately sculpted, hollowed-out [From.From.GetName].

But something about the scientist has changed.
anomaly_failure.2645.desc: In their last message, the crew of the [Root.GetName] reported aural activity spiking on [From.From.GetName] as they were approaching the surface. Communications were cut off shortly after, and the ship and all aboard are missing, presumed dead.
anomaly_failure.2650.desc:
The crew let the [Root.GetName] slip below minimum safe altitude in their attempt to gather as many ice samples as possible. By some happenstance atmospheric supercritical fluids got into the ship's rear thrusters, with disastrous results.

There were no survivors.
anomaly_failure.2655.desc: As the [Root.GetName] approaches [From.From.GetName], it is intercepted by a couple of less-than-friendly smuggling ships. The hostiles turn their weapons on the asteroid, destroying all evidence of whatever operation they were running there. The [Root.GetName] is next, it seems.
anomaly_failure.2660.desc:
The crew of the [Root.GetName] report that the ship's Science Officer took a particular interest in the rain on [From.From.GetName], as it is, in their words, "kind of purple."

Unfortunately, the precipitation samples retrieved turned out to be highly volatile, and once unsealed in the lab aboard the [Root.GetName] the liquid violently combusted, killing the Science Officer instantly.
anomaly_failure.2665.desc: In their last message, the crew of the [Root.GetName] reported activity spiking on [From.From.GetName] as they approached the surface. Communications were cut off shortly thereafter, and the ship and all aboard are missing, presumed dead.
anomaly_failure.2670.desc:
It appears as if the [Root.GetName]'s enthusiastic probing of the old construct's systems has, quite literally, backfired.

Before the ancient circuits finally fried, the [Root.GetName] managed to remotely activate the orbital station's positional thrusters - promptly knocking it out of its gentle orbit and into the star's gravity well. The mission's unfortunate outcome has had a profound impact on the ship's commander, [Root.GetLeaderName], who has grown from the experience.
anomaly_failure.4000.desc: [Root.GetLeaderName] has made a traumatizing discovery. The flora on [From.From.GetName] is extremely dangerous to non-plant organisms. We do not fully understand what is causing this; all we know is that large parts of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] is outright lethal and that this will restrict growth of potential settlements.
anomaly_failure.4000.a: This is truly a horrific place.
anomaly_failure.4000.a.tooltip:
Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] gains the Paranoid Trait.

Adds the Acid Jungles modifier to [From.From.GetName]:
£ Noxious Swamp +3
£ +6
anomaly_failure.4005.desc: Unfortunately, our team has not been able to deduce anything of great interest from the asteroid, as first expected, except for some common minerals.
anomaly_failure.4010.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that after extensive probing and scanning of the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon], nothing of interest has been found.
anomaly_failure.4011.desc: Having searched the ship and inspected the crew's remains, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has deduced that the crewmembers must have killed each other. The solitude and confinement of space travel can break even the strongest of minds.
anomaly_failure.4012.desc: We are receiving a distress signal from the [Root.GetName]. The crew has gone mad and are killing each other! The captain has lost all control, sending help would be futile at this point. Could this have anything to do with that derelict ship they recently investigated?
anomaly_failure.4015.desc: The [Root.GetName]'s crew report that they have found nothing of interest.
anomaly_failure.4025.desc: The science team of the [Root.GetName] reports that they have not found the impactful data they first expected [From.From.GetName] to hold.
anomaly_failure.4030.desc: Having combed the desert, we have not found anything of value!
anomaly_failure.4031.desc: We were unable to stall the fleet AI on [From.From.GetName]. Their ancient ships are taking to the skies and beyond, looking for the next battle according to their programmed parameters.
anomaly_failure.4031.a: The rage of the machine is worth fearing.
anomaly_failure.4035.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the radiation readings they so desperately wanted to examine were the result of a rare instrument malfunction. It has now been taken care of.
anomaly_failure.4037.desc: The radiation readings indicate that this is not the solar system we were looking for.
anomaly_failure.4045.desc: We simply cannot lock down what those subtle readings on [From.From.GetName] were. The team is frustrated and promise to improve.
anomaly_failure.4055.desc: The [Root.GetName] reports that they have been unable to find anything to deliver on the promised finds. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] is distraught and apologizes for the mistake.
anomaly_failure.4055.b: Do not make any more mistakes.
anomaly_failure.4060.desc: After closer inspection, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] only found random space debris orbiting the star. It probably originated from a nearby asteroid belt.
anomaly_failure.4066.desc: We could not stop the rampaging drill before it was too late. It dug too deep and was eventually crushed under the weight of rocky detritus of its own creation.
anomaly_failure.4070.desc: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] [From.From.GetName] follows the patterns expected of a tropical [From.From.GetPlanetMoon]. The anomaly that was detected seems to have been a dud.
anomaly_failure.4071.desc: Troublingly, we have found that [From.From.GetName] is very hostile, despite our initial scans pointing towards nothing of the sort. Potential colonizers would have to deal with terrible conditions, such as hazardous weathers, high temperatures and poisonous plants and wildlife.
anomaly_failure.4075.desc: The harsh climate has taken its toll and our science team have failed to reveal anything about [From.From.GetName] that we did not already know.
anomaly_failure.4080.desc: The [From.From.GetPlanetMoon] seems to be less interesting than we had hoped. The readings pointing to previous settlements seem to have been triggered by oddly symmetrical mineral formations.
anomaly_failure.4081.desc: Bad news from the repairs project on [From.From.From.GetName]. The construction workers have not been able to fix the broken machine, as it has started to break down even further and seems to be beyond repair.
anomaly_failure.4086.desc: Sadly we were not able to save the drifting ship close to [From.From.From.GetName] before it was too late. An untracked asteroid appeared on a collision course and smashed the ship to pieces.
anomaly_failure.4090.desc: We lost the signal. It appears to have come from a ship, but suddenly it just vanished. It might have performed an FTL jump, or something much worse happened to it.
anomaly_failure.4090.a: A new contact, lost to the void.
anomaly_failure.4090.b: Good. Alien interests are none of our concern.
anomaly_failure.4116.desc:
A last transmission has been received from the monster-infested ship. It tells us that the beast succeeded in getting through to the crew's hiding place.

The horrid encounter was far too graphic to describe. There were no survivors.
anomaly_failure.4136.desc: Sadly our linguists have been unable to understand the entirety of the alien language used in the old documents found on [From.From.From.GetName]. However, they managed to translate the essentials, which has given us a glimpse into the culture they originated from.
anomaly_failure.4156.desc: Fighting off the beasts around the underground vault on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] has caused the complex to collapse. We are unable to salvage anything of value from the debris.
anomaly_failure.4157.base: Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions.
anomaly_failure.4157.desc: Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions. We could reverse engineer this.
anomaly_failure.4157.maxed.desc:
Opening up the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] revealed it to hold samples of healthy crops, as well as instruments that would help it grow again in infertile conditions..

While not being that useful to us, there were also data on the civilization's culture and history, which could give us more insight into who they were.
anomaly_failure.4158.desc:
After opening the container we found on [WarriorHomePlanet.GetName] we were shocked to realize that it was a dispenser for a biological weapon!

The bio-weapon was made to target fertility functions and quickly spreads. It is however not entirely compatible with our DNA, and will not cause us to diminish in numbers.
anomaly_failure.4158.a.tooltip: Your Empire gains the Fertility Inhibiting Bio-Weapon modifier.
anomaly_failure.4170.base.desc: The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.
anomaly_failure.4170.individ.desc:
The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.

This backlash cannot be allowed to be repeated.
anomaly_failure.4170.basic.desc:
The gas mining facility on [From.GetName] has turned into a burning inferno. The report says that the highly volatile gas was exposed an open flame, causing multiple facilities to explode! This in turn caused a chain reaction and blew up most of the gas caches we had located.

The people who died in the explosion won't be forgotten.
anomaly_failure.4170.base.tooltip: Removes the modifier "Rich Gas Mining" from [From.GetName]
anomaly_failure.4170.a.tooltip: Removes the modifier "Rich Gas Mining" from [From.GetName].
anomaly_failure.4170.b.tooltip: Removes the modifier "Rich Gas Mining" from [From.GetName] and kills 100 £ Pops.
anomaly_failure.4170.c.tooltip: Removes the modifier "Rich Gas Mining" from [From.GetName] and kills 200 £ Pops.
anomaly_failure.4170.d.tooltip: Removes the modifier "Rich Gas Mining" from [From.GetName] and kills 300 £ Pops.
job_robot_caretaker_desc: A caretaker maintains the robot who has become something of a mascot for the planet.
job_turtle_miner_desc: Using powerful drills, we can harvest both the mineral shell and the  biological innards of the giant native Nemmas.
job_turtle_miner_gestalt_desc: Using powerful drills, we can harvest both the mineral shell and the  biological innards of the giant native Nemmas.

job_stratovent_researcher_desc: Researchers specialized in studying spaceborne fauna and guiding travelers to see them.
job_stratovent_refiner_desc: Workers specialized in gathering and refining precious gasses from the Stratospheric Vents.
job_stratovent_refiner_upg_desc: Researchers specialized in studying spaceborne fauna and educating travelers on their behavior.
job_stratovent_refiner_minerals_desc: Workers specialized in gathering and refining precious gasses from the Stratospheric Vents.
TRAIT_NOTOFTHISWORLD_EFFECT: Every 100 £ Pops working as a slave or better produces 0.5 £ Physics Research per month.
job_puddle_technician_desc: Diversification of food production is a worthwhile endeavor.
job_puddle_technician_drone_desc: Utilizing the unique meteorology to harvest additional resources will benefit the collective.
job_manufactorium_specialist_desc: These highly skilled workers operate delicate and ancient machinery, creating resources at a fraction of the usual cost.
job_manufactorium_complex_drone_desc: These highly specialized drones operate delicate and ancient machinery, creating resources at a fraction of the usual cost.
job_manufactorium_scraper_desc: Breaking the ancient machinery apart is a risky but rewarding task. These workers will have a lot on their hands, given the size of the facility.
job_manufactorium_scraper_drone_desc: Breaking the ancient machinery apart is a risky but rewarding task. These drones will have a lot on their hands, given the size of the facility.
job_manufactorium_researcher_desc: Construction engineers, researchers, sociologists, workers, and security staff are all working together to uncover the mysteries of the Vault.
job_manufactorium_research_drone_desc: Construction, logic, worker, and security drones are cooperating to uncover the mysteries of the Vault.
mod_job_manufactorium_research_drone_per: +1 Vault Research Unit Job per $VALUE$ Pops
mod_job_manufactorium_researcher_per_pop: +1 Vault Research Team Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_stasis_warden_desc: Wardens maintain the stasis prison, along with marking citizens for disappearance.
job_stasis_warden_drone_desc: Warden drones maintain the stasis prison, along with marking deviants for disappearance.
mod_job_stasis_warden_drone_per_pop: +1 Stasis Warden Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_astrogarbage_collector_desc: A special unit responsible for collecting space debris from planetary orbit.
job_astrogarbage_collector_gestalt_desc: A special drone unit responsible for collecting space debris from planetary orbit.
job_myrmeku_power_farmer_desc: Technicians that harness energy from Myrmeku colonies.
mod_job_myrmeku_power_farmer_per_pop: +1 Myrmeku Power Farmer Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_myrmeku_power_farmer_gestalt_desc: Tech-Drones that harness energy from Myrmeku colonies.
mod_job_myrmeku_power_farmer_gestalt_per: +1 Myrmeku Power Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
planet_myrmeku_attacks_desc: [Owner.GetColonistPluralCapital] have been attacked by tiny insects.
planet_myrmeku_seal_colony_desc: Special care has been taken to seal off all buildings from the local fauna.
planet_myrmeku_upgrade_robots_desc: [Owner.GetColonistPluralCapital] are designed with extra protection for their mechanical innards.
planet_myrmeku_pest_control_desc: The destruction of insect colonies on the surface has been made a priority.
planet_myrmeku_lured_desc: Memory chip insulation material has been distributed across the terrain.
job_mineral_diver_desc: Deep sea experts who recover sunken minerals from the ocean depths.
job_mineral_diver_per_pop: +1 Deep Sea Diver Job per $VALUE$ Pops
mod_job_mineral_diver_per_pop: +1 Deep Sea Diver Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_mineral_diver_drone_desc: Mining Drones that can withstand great pressure to collect sunken minerals from the ocean depths.
job_alien_hunter_desc: A special task force assigned to hunt alien fauna.
anomaly_pulsating_object_desc: Initial scans of [this.GetName] have discovered a peculiar airborne object floating through the troposphere, shrinking and swelling in size as it changes positions. Further investigation is necessary in order to classify its nature.
anomaly_molten_metal_ocean_desc: Initial surveys of [from.GetName]'s surface have detected frequent tsunamis of superheated lava containing high concentrations of heavy metals. Further analysis will be necessary to fully understand this phenomenon.
planet_thrusters_desc: Suspended within the upper atmosphere of [from.GetName] is a series of large cylindrical machines. They appear inactive devoid of any crew.
job_fe_overseer_desc: The stalwart few have rejected lives of luxury in favor of public service. It is up to them to oversee and guide the remnants of their ancient civilization.
job_fe_maintenance_bot_desc: These ancient machines tirelessly maintain and repair the decaying machinery of the ringworld on which they reside.
job_fe_guardian_bot_desc: These ancient machines maintain a ceaseless vigil over the expired remains of billions of cryogenically frozen sapients.
job_fe_hedonist_desc: A life of total opulence, where every possible material need or desire can be satisfied.
job_fe_archivist_desc: Each data fragment must be filed, cataloged, and indexed precisely according to the ancient rites established eons ago by the First Librarian.
job_fe_acolyte_farm_desc: Was it, not the plow, this noblest of instruments, that Kazargiel used to sever the poisonous tail of the thrice-cursed demon and stave off famine?
job_fe_acolyte_farm_effect_desc: £ Acolytes of the Plow produce £ Food
job_fe_acolyte_mine_desc: And with one mighty blow, Saint Mazakudal used her burning hammer to split the skull of the First Wraith in two, opening up the path to the crystals.
job_fe_acolyte_mine_effect_desc: £ Acolytes of the Hammer produce £ Minerals
job_fe_acolyte_generator_desc: Remember also the hyper spanner and how it was used by Bazagg the Shining to tame the sun when it seemed like darkness would overtake the world.
job_fe_acolyte_generator_effect_desc: £ Acolytes of the Hyperspanner produce £ Energy Credits
job_fe_acolyte_artisan_desc: And so Aznakha said to the acolytes, 'Go to the workshops, and form with your crafts the future you seek'.
job_fe_acolyte_artisan_effect_desc: £ Acolytes of the Workshop produce £ Supplies
job_fe_protector_desc: So that the majority can rest peacefully and enjoy their lives of extravagance, these rough individuals stand ready in the night to visit violence on those who would do them harm.
job_fe_augur_desc: It speaks, but not in words. To divine any meaning, one must hover on the precipice of madness.
job_fe_sky_cardinal_desc: And it was there, in the sky, that the future was born. The light was blinding, but a few could see past it. They took it upon themselves to lead others forward.
job_fe_xeno_ward_desc: These specimens have been gathered here, in settings that approximate their natural environments, to ensure the preservation of their species in an often chaotic and destructive galaxy.
job_fe_xeno_keeper_desc: These precursor zookeepers look after the needs of the Xeno-Wards under their care.
edict_extended_healthcare_coverage_desc: This Edict provides additional resources to Gene Clinics and Cyto-Revitalization Centers facilities.
edict_extended_healthcare_coverage_toolt: Planets with Gene Clinics or Cyto-Revitalization Centers gain +10% Pop Growth.
edict_nutritional_plenitude_desc: It is the fundamental right of each of our citizens to enter hibernation with a full digestive organ. Easy access to plentiful, nutritional fare will be the fuel that spurs our growth among the stars.
edict_nutritional_plenitude_hive_desc: It is the fundamental right of each of our citizens to enter hibernation with a full digestive organ. Easy access to plentiful, nutritional fare will be the fuel that spurs our growth among the stars.
edict_evacuation_protocols_desc: We must establish a new home and prepare to evacuate our homeworld.
edict_extended_shifts_desc: We must ask our workers to toil harder. A few broken bodies do not weigh much against the Greater Good.
edict_drone_overdrive_desc: Our drones will be worked harder, as more resources are required.
edict_expanded_breeding_program_desc: This Edict provides additional resources to the spawning pools.
edict_expanded_breeding_program_tooltip: Planets with Spawning Pools gain +10% Pop Growth.
edict_expanded_breeding_program_servitor: Using gamification and point-based reward schemes, we will subtly encourage our Bio-Trophies to fill our Organic Sanctuaries.
Planets with Organic Sanctuary or Organic Paradise gain +10% Pop Growth.
edict_fortify_the_border_desc: Defense of our systems is paramount. This Edict will direct additional resources to these ends.
edict_fleet_supremacy_desc: Our navy is our best means to project power. This Edict will prioritize them above lesser needs.
edict_capacity_subsidies_desc: This Edict allows short-term overloading of energy grids, letting power plants across our empire run at increased capacity.
edict_mining_subsidies_desc: This Edict is a focused administrative effort to reprioritize and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.
edict_industrial_subsidies_desc: Success can be measured by the acquisition of things. This Edict provides our factories with additional resources so production can be increased.
edict_forge_subsidies_desc: Our empire thirsts for more specialized alloys and precious metals. This Edict provides our foundries with additional resources so production can be increased.
edict_research_subsidies_desc: Knowledge is power. This Edict focuses our efforts on advancing technology.
edict_research_subsidies_tooltip: Increases the upkeep of £ Researchers by £1
edict_veneration_of_saints_desc: Rather than focusing exclusively on this temporal world, we should provide our spiritual guides with whatever they need to prepare us for the next.

origin_syncretic_evolution_desc: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.
origin_life_seeded_desc: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

origin_post_apocalyptic_desc: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.
origin_post_apocalyptic_machines_desc: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old world.
origin_shattered_ring_desc: This civilization inhabits a Ring World built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.

origin_remnants_desc: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.
origin_tree_of_life_desc: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.

job_output_1_desc: Freed of the toxic, internecine bickering that characterized interstellar relations before the rise of our union, partner states can now focus their energies on productive labor for the good of all.
job_output_2_desc: The grand idea which unifies our peoples is more important than the whims or convenience of any individual being. Sacrifices must be made on the path to progress.
job_output_3_desc: We need no longer confront the angst and doubt of questions about our role in the federation. When asked 'how much should we be prepared to give?', the only answer is 'everything'.
edict_greater_than_ourselves_desc: Encourages free unemployed pops to voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire.
job_gas_plant_engineer_desc: These workers operate the massive filter facilities built over Cave Mushroom spore exhausts.
mod_job_gas_plant_engineer_per_pop: +1 Gas Plant Engineer Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_gas_plant_engineer_gestalt_desc: These drones maintain and operate the massive filter facilities built on top of Cave Mushroom spore exhausts.
mod_job_gas_plant_engineer_gestalt_per_p: +1 Gas Plant Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_cave_cleaner_desc: These workers clear out burned-out Cave Mushroom passages to unearth mineral veins.
job_cave_cleaner_gestalt_desc: These workers clear out burned-out Cave Mushroom passages to unearth mineral veins.
mod_job_cave_cleaner_gestalt_per_pop: +1 Cave Cleaner Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
origin_galactic_doorstep_desc: This civilization has a dormant Gateway in their home system - potential technological benefit, or a looming menace?
origin_eldest_sibling_desc: This society has an old legend about splinter groups of the population who left the planet in search for other planets to colonize in the solar system.
origin_tooltip_eldest_sibling_effects: - Start with two other primitive civilizations in your home system.
origin_shoulders_of_giants_desc: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.
origin_tooltips_shoulders_of_giants_effe: - Home System: ['concept_ex_gravitas'] ['concept_archaeology_site'] related to a mysterious benefactor
origin_tooltips_shoulders_of_giants_nega: - Precursor Event Chains blocked until this mystery is solved
origin_fallen_empire_desc: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.
origin_enlightened_desc: The natural development of this civilization was greatly accelerated by the interference of another party, who helped them become a spacefaring culture.
origin_fallen_empire_hive_desc: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.
origin_default_pre_ftl_desc: This civilization has yet to become spacefaring, however with a little encouragement or a great deal of time they may yet become an actor on the galactic stage.
origin_void_dwellers_desc: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.
origin_tooltip_void_dwellers_effects:

planet_destruction.1000.name: Observation of [From.GetName] Ceases
planet_destruction.1000.desc.self: Although using our superweapons against a [GetPreFTLLower] civilization is certainly amusing, it also means that there is now nothing left to observe there...

ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile: Who are you to oppose the will of the people?!

ethic_egalitarian_warning_hostile_1: What heartless monster would vote against justice and equality?
ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile: If you vote against us, I don't think we can be friends anymore.

ethic_xenophile_warning_hostile_1: Please do not vote against us. It would be very, very sad.
ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile: Do not vote against us; your species need not prove its inferiority any further.

ethic_xenophobe_warning_hostile_1: Don't prove your cultural deficiencies more than you already have. Do not oppose us.

ethic_materialist_warning_hostile_1: Opposing us in the upcoming vote wouldn't be practical. You should be practical.
ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile: Your feeble mind cannot see the full range of woes coming your way if you oppose us.
ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile_0: Who are you to question divine right?!
ethic_spiritualist_warning_hostile_1: Do not oppose us. It will crush your spirit, and the body will follow.
ethic_hivemind_warning_hostile: The notion of 'opposition' is new to us. We do not like it. Not one bit.
ethic_hivemind_warning_hostile_0: Do not oppose $GREETER$. We are bad at... what's the word... 'tolerating'.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_neutral_0: We appreciate your effort to create a galaxy of unity.

ethic_pacifist_appreciation_hostile_0: We may have to revise our stance on $COUNTRY$: not without hope.

ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_neutral: Now you see that our authority is just.
Our authority should not be questioned.
ethic_authoritarian_appreciation_hostile: Maybe there's hope for you yet.

ethic_egalitarian_appreciation_friendly: A true servant of the many.

ethic_spiritualist_appreciation_hostile_: So, does this mean that $COUNTRY$ wishes to redeem itself?

ethic_militarist_consequence_hostile_1: The face of the enemy has been revealed.

ethic_pacifist_consequence_hostile_1: Do you not see the error of your ways?!
ethic_authoritarian_consequence_hostile: You dare oppose us like this?! Fool!

TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_1_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Basic Cloaking Field Generator
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_1_DESC:
Basic Cloaking Field Generator
A modified particle field allows our vessels to effectively 'hide' in open space. However, this comes at the cost of destabilizing other forms of energy shielding which would otherwise protect the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Advanced Cloaking Field Generator
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_2_DESC:
Advanced Cloaking Field Generator
Advancements in rare crystal lensing technology have greatly improved cloaking efficiency.
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Elite Cloaking Field Generator
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_3_DESC:
Elite Cloaking Field Generator
Typical cloaking technology can play havoc with a ship's more delicate instruments. However, these elite fields render such concerns obsolete.
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_DARK_MATTER_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Dark Matter Cloaking Field Generator
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_DARK_MATTER_DESC:
Dark Matter Cloaking Field Generator
This device uses dark matter to warp space-time around the vessel, making it incredibly difficult to detect.
TECH_UNLOCK_CLOAKING_PSI_DESC:
Psi-Phase Field Generator
Psi-Phase Field Generators focus the psionic potential of the ship's crew to partially phase the vessel into the Shroud. This allows the ship to remain undetected by all but the best sensor arrays, though what the crew may be forced to witness is better left unsaid.
origin_slavers_desc:
From the moment the Board of Directors at Minamar Specialized Industries first delivered our civilization to the stars, we have understood that the galaxy was too beautiful not to be shared. Since then, we have worked tirelessly to help less developed civilizations achieve FTL travel.

Enlightenment may not be free. But at MSI, it is always worth the cost.

- Allows the Raiding bombardment stance, which abducts £ Pops from planets and resettles them to your colonies.

Unlocks the Memorial to the Unshackled decision on [Root.Capital.GetName].
- The Crashed Slaver Ship and related infrastructure will be converted into advanced infrastructure.
- The Scavenger Sites will now provide [clerk.GetIcon] [clerk.GetNamePlural] Jobs instead of £ Scavenger Jobs.
job_low_tech_researcher_desc: Our former masters ignored our gifts and downplayed our intelligence. Now, the keenest minds among us are free to follow their ambition.
job_low_tech_laborer_desc: As assets they were worked to the bone. With freedom has come renewed purpose, and a vigor that no slave could ever hope to match.
job_low_tech_laborer_effect_desc: £ Laborers turn £ Minerals into £ Supplies and £ Alloys
job_low_tech_technician_desc: Aboard their masters' vessels, indentured engineers were often assigned the lowliest and most dangerous jobs. This hardship only sharpened their skills.
job_low_tech_miner_desc: Stubborn, ill-mannered, indomitable; these former indentured miners are as solid as scrap metal.
job_low_tech_farmer_desc: The agri-worlds of our former masters were scenes of brutal oppression. Now, our homesteaders are free to enjoy the fruits of their labor.
job_low_tech_priest_desc: Our preachers remind us that freedom is a divine right; united in faith, we find our common strength.
job_low_tech_priest_effect_desc: £ Preachers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities
job_low_tech_warrior_desc: Indentured soldiers were mainly used as cannon fodder; the fortunate few who survived have volunteered to protect our newfound freedom with their lives.
job_low_tech_warrior_effect_desc: £ Military Conscripts decrease £ Crime and spawn £ Defense Armies
job_low_tech_bureaucrat_desc: Our former masters delegated much of their empire's day-to-day administration to indentured assets. The result was a class of highly trained logistics personnel.
job_low_tech_manager_desc: Our former masters delegated much of their empire's day-to-day administration to indentured assets. The result was a class of highly trained managers.
job_low_tech_manager_effect_desc: £ Supervisors turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Trade
job_broken_shackles_scavenger_desc: Scavengers explore the ruins of the Crashed Slaver Ship for anything of value.
job_broken_shackles_scavenger_effect_des: £ Scavengers produce small amounts of £ Alloys, £ Amenities, and £ £ £ Research.
origin_fear_of_the_dark_desc: A century ago, one of the planets in this empire's home system was destroyed by a freak asteroid. Some believed this was a malicious attack by an alien species. Others brushed off these concerns as mere paranoia. The tension between the two groups grew so great that a newly-terraformed planet was granted to the fearmongers.
origin_tooltip_fear_of_the_dark_effects: - Home System: ['concept_preftl_civilizations', Pre-FTL Civilization] created by a Separatist Faction, formerly part of your Empire, granting events and benefits
job_fotd_protectors_desc: So that the majority can rest peacefully and enjoy their lives of extravagance, these rough individuals stand ready in the night to visit violence on those who would do them harm.

TECH_UNLOCK_SUBSPACE_DRIVE_DESC:
Jump Drive
An insight borne of a desperate desire to leave our home, these Subspace Drive engines were designed to facilitate limited interstellar travel. While only allowing small-scale jumps, they provide a unique opportunity to jumpstart our galactic exploration.
job_solarpunk_anarchist_desc: Having achieved their utopia these world sculptors are glad to rest.

origin_primal_calling_desc:
The rustle of bladed grass. The roaring silence of the night. The will of the hunter, sharp and cold as starlight...

This civilization has a primal connection to the wild. Viewing themselves as stewards to the diverse (and often deadly) wildlife native to their world, they now turn their gaze skyward. Masters of animal handling and ranching, this relationship with fauna has developed according to their ethics. How this bond will evolve on a galactic scale remains to be seen.
