planet_crystalose_desc_short: These sucrose crystals are able to multiply by absorbing solar radiation and specific minerals present within certain asteroids
planet_crystalose_desc_details: Due to their extremely brittle nature, they are relatively easy to cultivate and process. Their industrial applications range from foodstuffs to the development of specialized polymers and medicine.
planet_pushing_thruster_desc_short: These massive propulsion devices, when connected in series, are theoretically capable of influencing a small planet's orbit
planet_pushing_thruster_desc_details: The intended mounting system for these thrusting arrays is designed to push the planet without affecting its rotation. The main logistical concern with this type of engine technology would be the inordinate quantity of fuel required to sustain its use. It would take the coordination of an entire civilization to maintain its operation.
planet_super_roots_desc_short: Found in the forests of [From.GetName], these naturally pulpy roots have been found to be highly nutritious
planet_super_roots_desc_details: With careful management, harvesting only a portion of their extensive networks allow the host plants to survive while supporting developing colonies. We have already begun experimenting with a simple genetic modification that will allow the grafting if these roots into existing crops for an extra yield to the harvests.
planet_vaccine_desc_short: The miracle cure developed for the mutating disease that plagued [this.GetName]
planet_vaccine_desc_details: This formula was developed by using AI predictive algorithms to map out all of the possible variants of the disease and identify a fundamental weakness common to the whole. Its creation was a landmark advancement in the field of medical science.
TECH_UNLOCK_AKX_WORM_3_DESC: When a temporal paradox becomes tangled, a kind of consciousness arises, with its own needs, its own desires. This is what has occurred with the consciousness that some call the Worm-in-Waiting. If we can align ourselves with that consciousness, we might just achieve a kind of immortality.
edict_entropy_harnessing_desc: Integrating Crystallized Entropy production into our infrastructure allows us to fully harness our technical prowess, and exploit this volatile new resource to its fullest potential.

origin_red_giant_desc:
This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.

Can they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?
origin_cosmic_dawn_desc: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

job_fire_oracle_effect_desc: £ Fire Oracles replace £ Politicians on planets with Habitability lower than 50%. They turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities.

job_radiant_priest_desc: To keep burning the flames of faith, this society's ruling priesthood embodies the radiant light of holy fire, lighting the way for their followers and cleansing evil from society.
job_radiant_priest_effect_desc: £ Radiant Priests replace £ Politicians on planets with Habitability lower than 50%. They turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities.
job_pyrocrat_desc: An entrenched elite whose brilliance defines the state, Pyrocrats rule as living flames and are sustained by the labor of those who stoke their glory.
job_pyrocrat_effect_desc: £ Pyrocrats replace £ Politicians on planets with Habitability lower than 50%. They turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities.
job_ashbroker_desc: Where fire consumes, Ashbrokers thrive. These profiteers of ruin are skilled in turning devastation into opportunity and ashes into assets.
job_ashbroker_effect_desc: £ Ashbrokers replace £ Politicians on planets with Habitability lower than 50%. They turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities.
job_blazing_harbinger_desc: Revered as both visionaries and leaders, these harbingers unite faith and authority. Through sacred flame, they guide the empire toward its destined radiance.
job_blazing_harbinger_effect_desc: £ Blazing Harbingers replace £ Politicians on planets with Habitability lower than 50%. They turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities and £ Stability.

TECH_UNLOCK_COSMOWORLD_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Synaptic Lathe
Colossal in scale, the Synaptic Lathe is a reservoir computer. The processing power of our population's networked minds is used to compute and store data. The benefits are obvious, but some misguided species may view the transmutation of individuals into computing chips as morally questionable.
TECH_UNLOCK_ESCORT_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Riddle Escort
A starship of modest size that optimizes our knowledge of spacetime to enact dimensional transcendentalism, making the inside bigger than its outward shape suggests. Advanced firepower capabilities come at a reduced logistical cost compared to traditional ship designs.
TECH_UNLOCK_BATTLECRUISER_CONSTRUCTION_D:
Enigma Battlecruiser
Another optimized spacecraft, this time of larger dimensions, will make current Battleships look like toys.
TECH_UNLOCK_FETITAN_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Paradox Titan
These formidable ships are closer to mobile fortresses than anything else, and only the most brutal assaults have a chance to damage them.
job_neural_chip_desc: A single Neural Chip is inconsequential. Once connected, their processing capabilities increase exponentially.
job_neural_chip_processing_desc: A single Neural Chip is inconsequential. Once connected, their processing capabilities increase exponentially.
job_neural_chip_unprocessing_desc: A single Neural Chip is inconsequential. Once connected, their processing capabilities increase exponentially.
pop_cat_chip_slave_desc: These individuals are used as chips in a computer of gigantic scale. Deep in an artificial coma, life pods ensure maximum longevity. Eventually, the massive strain of the processing load will cause cognitive organs to break down.

Evangelical mechanics and surgeons of the divine, rendering unworthy [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and replacing it with holy cybernetics.

This £ Job requires the £ Pop to have the Ritualistic Implants of any Cybernetic Creed or Cybernetic trait.

job_technophant_desc:
Exalted interpreters of divine wetware. They guide the people toward a perfect fusion of [Owner.Species.GetFleshTypeCyberCreed] and machine.

This £ Job requires the £ Pop to have the Ritualistic Implants of any Cybernetic Creed or Cybernetic trait.

edict_cybernetic_creed_construction_edic: For a divine society, we must fully back the Fellowship of the Hammer, whose work is key to building a future that merits the divine.
edict_cybernetic_creed_war_edict_desc: To guard against fiends attacking our divine flesh, we must fully support the Templars of Steel, ensuring our warriors are always prepared.
edict_cybernetic_creed_research_edict_de: Only through a vibrant song of knowledge shall our people ever truly know the divine. We must support our wise Choir of the Mind in all their endeavors.
edict_cybernetic_creed_construction_labo: Our true strength lies in our laborers. If we do not have the strength to lift them up, then they will not have the strength to carry us to the future.
edict_cybernetic_creed_general_edict_des: Unifying the Church brought many lessons. It's made our faith stronger and more contemplative than ever.
origin_arc_welders_desc:
Their planet is barren, but their home system is a bounty of riches. To exploit it, these machines built bigger than ever before. A mighty Arc Furnace now dominates their sky, but these master engineers are far from satisfied.

The galaxy awaits, and the possibilities are endless. All it takes is the ingenuity to seize them.

edict_nanotech_alloy_augmentation_desc: Infusing alloy lattices with nanites enables faster, better, and more precise alloy production along new baseline regenerative metallic properties.

job_cyberdome_spectator_desc: Spectators enjoy games in the Cyberdome. When witnessed via cyberbrain, even the cheapest seats provide a spectacle, but when neurocasting is enabled it's possible to experience gladiatorial combat in first person.
policy_cyberization_standards_desc: Population-wide implants are necessary for our society, but those against full cyberization may opt for limited augmentation.
edict_legislative_chorus_desc: The cacophony of the individualized voting streams is divided into manageable data chunks, significantly improving response speed.
edict_self_preservation_override_desc: By remotely disabling the threat response mechanisms of the brain, enhanced citizens accept riskier work assignments.
edict_battle_royale_desc: Activate a gamified quota interface to entice specialists and workers to compete for promotions and performance badges. The nature of the endless grind partially offsets the increase in productivity.
edict_stately_acclaim_desc: The oligarchy highlights the incredible efforts of the currently exploited faction, increasing their approval and attraction. This fleeting fame can also lead to increased social mobility.

edict_self_indictment_protocol_desc: Enables a hidden personal implant feature which uses heuristic live feed analysis to detect and report crimes without requiring the owner's consent.
edict_love_letter_virus_desc: Triggers implants to produce more pheromones and other chemicals in order to coax more "amorous" behavior towards other people in different parts of the empire.
edict_levied_experience_desc: By extracting our population's knowledge using cybernetics, we can improve our leader's experience without wasting their time with menial tasks.
edict_neurocasted_spectacles_desc: By neurocasting the brutal sport spectacles of the capital's Cyberdome directly to the cyberbrain, people flock to the capital. With their bodies safe in pods, spectators share the gladiators' experiences in first-person. A year of games!

edict_rolling_updates_desc: Automated and user-independent deployment of implant updates removes the need for monolithic infrastructure. This also keeps us one step ahead of hostile cyber-incursions.
edict_hive_mind_outreach_desc: The will of a determined mind moves faster than the speed of light.
edict_hive_hyper_stimulants_desc: Cybernetic implants automatically administer boosting drugs to our drones, increasing performance.
edict_hive_mega_construction_desc: This Edict allocates additional resources to our Mega-Engineering program, speeding up the construction of new galactic structures.
edict_aggregated_memory_desc: The memories of our assimilated population cascade like a rushing torrent. Their collective experience is ours to wield.
edict_choral_harmony_desc: To compose a song, there must be harmony; let the minds of our assimilated population be unified.

ethic_authoritarian_desc: A strong, guiding hand is essential to the success of any civilization - the alternative would be anarchy and chaos. It is the duty of the state to steer its citizens towards the paths that are the most productive.
ethic_fanatic_authoritarian_desc: A single voice, a single throne, a single state. It is the solemn duty of the masses to obey those enlightened few who have been charged with the great responsibility of leadership.
ethic_egalitarian_desc: Any society that does not embrace equality between its members - where an individual can rise to any position with enough hard work - is not only deeply unfair, but ultimately counterproductive.
ethic_fanatic_egalitarian_desc: Beware always those who would be despots, under the false presumption that their desires and agendas are somehow more imperative than those of their fellows. A society that does not see to the needs and rights of all of its members is not a society - it is a crime.
ethic_xenophobe_desc: The stakes could not be higher as we reach into the vast uncharted expanses of the galaxy, for we are gambling with the very survival of our species! Never trust the alien; its false smile hides an unknowable mind...
ethic_fanatic_xenophobe_desc: Any alien influence must be ruthlessly quashed. Only by staying pure, and true to ourselves and the planet that gave us life can we guard against insidious Xeno plots. Even mastery over the Alien might not be enough to guarantee our own safety...
ethic_xenophile_desc: There exists, in all of us, a deep-seated fascination for the unknown. An adventurous spirit that rejects the familiar and glories in the unfamiliar, whatever - or whomever - it may be.
ethic_fanatic_xenophile_desc: If there ever was such a thing as an absolute moral imperative, it would be to explore the cosmos and embrace all within it. We were never meant to journey alone.
ethic_militarist_desc: The only true virtues are courage and discipline, and channeled properly they can overcome any obstacle. Therein lies true strength; force withheld, a promise made.
ethic_fanatic_militarist_desc: The ability to project force is of paramount importance. The only way to preserve our way of life is to make sure everyone shares it; willingly or not...
ethic_pacifist_desc: Conflict as a means to an end is a ridiculous concept. It is by nature destructive, destroying what was to be obtained or giving room to grow that which was to be destroyed.
ethic_fanatic_pacifist_desc: As civilized beings, the end of all armed conflict should be our primary concern. War is an evolutionary dead end, as futile as it is wasteful.
ethic_spiritualist_desc: There are those who think it behooves us to remember how tiny we are, how pointless our lives are in this vast uncaring universe... What nonsense! The only truth we can ever know is that of our own existence. The universe - in all its apparent glory - is but a dream we all happen to share.
ethic_fanatic_spiritualist_desc: Our science has proved that Consciousness begets reality. We regard with patience the childlike efforts of those who delude themselves it is the other way around, as they play with their blocks of "hard matter."
ethic_materialist_desc: As we reach for the stars, we must put away childish things; gods, spirits and other phantasms of the brain. Reality is cruel and unforgiving, yet we must steel ourselves and secure the survival of our race through the unflinching pursuit of science and technology.
ethic_fanatic_materialist_desc: Although it hurts, we must grow up and put aside our outdated notions of morality. There is no "divine spark" granting special value to a living mind. No object has any intrinsic value apart from what we choose to grant it. Let us embrace the freedom of certitude, and achieve maximum efficiency in all things!
ethic_neutral_desc: The neutral mind is the free mind, open to all possibilities...
ethic_gestalt_consciousness_desc:
We reach into the void.
The vast expanse becomes us.

Defense Platform
Allows the construction of additional hull types.

TECH_VIEW_AUTO_RESEARCH_DESC: Click to set research options to be picked automatically.
TECH_VIEW_AUTO_RESEARCH_DISABLE_DESC: Click to set research options to be picked manually.
TECH_ALWAYS_AVAILABLE: This Technology will remain as a valid option until it is researched.
TECH_UNLOCK_IMPROVED_UPLINKS_FORMS_DESC:
Improved Assist Research
Assist Research is now twice as effective.
TECH_UNLOCK_DIPLOMATIC_ACTION_CREATE_ALL:
Form Alliance
Allows us to form an Alliance with other Empires.
TECH_UNLOCK_DIPLOMATIC_ACTION_CREATE_FED:
Form Federation
Allows us to form a Federation with other Empires.
TECH_UNLOCK_DIPLOMATIC_ACTION_CREATE_VAS: Unlocks Diplomacy: Vassal States and Protectorates

Subjugation
Allows us to subjugate other Empires, offering protection under our rule. Most empires will act as Vassals, but technologically inferior nations will become Protectorates. We may also ask to become subjects, should we need protection.
TECH_UNLOCK_SURVEY_INTEL_DESC:
Survey Data
Allows us to view other Empires' survey data on planets within their borders.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORDER_EXTRUDER_2_DESC:
Boosted Border Beacon
Expands and demarcates our borders in interstellar space.
TECH_UNLOCK_BORDER_EXTRUDER_3_DESC:
Advanced Border Beacon
Becoming rulers supreme is our destiny, and this fact must be made manifest to those who would oppose us!
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTER_PRECOG_DESC:
Precognitive Interface
Advances in the field of Psionics suggest the possibility of creating combat computers capable of reading and analyzing the impulses of telepathic operatives before they are cognitively processed.
TECH_UNLOCK_TERRAFORMING_TEMP_CHANGE_DES:
Atmospheric Manipulation 
Allows us to also change the climate of planets when terraforming them.
TECH_UNLOCK_VOLCANO_TERRAFORM_DESC: Allows us to terraform Volcanic Worlds into temperate climates.
TECH_UNLOCK_VOLCANIC_TERRAFORM_DESC: Allows us to terraform Volcanic Worlds into temperate climates.
TECH_UNLOCK_TERRAFORMING_GAIA_CHANGE_DES:
Atmospheric Manipulation
Allows us to terraform worlds into Gaia planets.
TECH_UNLOCK_TERRAFORMING_NUKED_CHANGE_DE:
Climate Restoration
Allows us to terraform ecologically devastated worlds.
TECH_UNLOCK_SPACEPORT_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Spaceport
A Spaceport is required to build any type of ship capable of spaceflight. It can be upgraded with additional functions and carries basic defenses.
TECH_UNLOCK_SCIENCE_SHIP_CONSTRUCTION_DE:
Science Ship 
The Science Ship is used as a base of operations for a top scientist, ready to explore the vastness of space.
TECH_UNLOCK_CONSTRUCTION_SHIP_CONSTRUCTI:
Construction Ship 
The Construction Ship allows for the assembly of various space stations, through the use of advanced welding-drones.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLONY_SHIP_CONSTRUCTION_DES:
Colony Ship 
Colony ships are single-use vessels for settling on alien worlds. Upon colonization, the ship is scuttled and converted into a planetary shelter and foothold.
TECH_UNLOCK_CORVETTE_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Patrol Frigate 
A small and cheap class of starship, often the first that a civilisation will develop. This ship has limited capabilities and options available but can be surprisingly effective due to its small size making it hard to hit.
TECH_UNLOCK_DESTROYER_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Destroyer
As a larger two-section design, the Destroyer offers a broad array of strategic armament options.
TECH_UNLOCK_CRUISER_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Cruiser
The Cruiser is the first three-section design, allowing for a wide range of module configurations for those willing to pay the price.
TECH_UNLOCK_BATTLESHIP_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Battleship
The largest regular hull configuration available, the Battleship carries immense power into battle at even greater cost and reduced maneuverability.
TECH_UNLOCK_TITAN_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Titan
These massive warships are the pride of the fleet. They are bristling with weapons and typically serve as flagships.
TECH_UNLOCK_JUGGERNAUT_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Juggernaut
These colossal constructs are as much space stations as they are ships. The juggernaut is an immense mobile space station that can repair and construct ships, which means it can serve as a forward base of operations during offensive campaigns.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_PLATFORM_DESC:
Defense Platform
This will enable the construction of defensive deep space platforms to protect our Starbases.
TECH_UNLOCK_DEFENSE_STATION_DESC:
Defense Station
New construction methods will allow for the construction of even larger military stations in the depths of space.
TECH_UNLOCK_FORTRESS_DESC:
Fortress
These massive installations are like cities floating in space. They can support a crew of thousands, and are often equipped with firepower rivaling that of a fleet.
TECH_UNLOCK_MINING_STATION_DESC:
Mining Station 
A Mining Station can extract a planet's deposits of Minerals and valuable resources from orbit.
TECH_UNLOCK_RESEARCH_STATION_DESC:
Research Station 
A Research Station can study various planetary phenomena from orbit, gathering valuable scientific data.
TECH_UNLOCK_AFTERBURNER_1_DESC:
Afterburners
These powerful thrusters provide additional combat speed but consume a great deal of power.
TECH_UNLOCK_AFTERBURNER_2_DESC:
Advanced Afterburners
This improved version of the standard afterburners provide an even greater boost to a ship's combat speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_1_DESC:
Micro-Fusion Thruster 
A powerful thruster system that builds upon the ancient principle of making something move by expelling a hot, expanding gas. This engine expels hot, high-pressure plasma.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_2_DESC:
Ion Thruster
These electric thrusters use beams of ions to generate thrust without the need for propellant.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3_DESC:
Plasma Thruster
An advanced form of electric propulsion, plasma thrusters afford ships greater sublight speeds and maneuverability.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4_DESC:
Impulse Thruster
These highly advanced fusion-powered thrusters provide ships with unmatched maneuverability and speed under sublight conditions.
TECH_UNLOCK_SENSOR_2_DESC:
Gravitic Sensors
These sensors have been tuned to look for any gravitational changes in space, such as those produced by the presence of a starship.
TECH_UNLOCK_SENSOR_3_DESC:
Subspace Sensors
Sensors that detect the subspace fluctuations left in the wake of traveling starships. Their sensitivity and range is greater than that of a gravitic sensor array.
TECH_UNLOCK_SENSOR_4_DESC:
Tachyon Sensors
Advanced sensors that rely on rotating tachyon beams to detect ship movements even at extreme distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_1_DESC:
Basic Combat Roles
Recent progress in AI behavioral theory allows us to designate specific combat roles to our shipboard computers.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_2_DESC:
Advanced Combat Roles
Further advances in adaptive combat algorithms enables our shipboard AI to handle its assigned role far more effectively.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_3_DESC:
Sapient Combat AI
Exploiting our sapient AI's sense of self-preservation, or fear of death, should greatly enhance its responsiveness in combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_COMBAT_COMPUTERS_AUTONOMOUS_:
Autonomous Ship Intellects
Granting our ships their own semi-autonomous intellect will greatly enhance their responsiveness in combat.
TECH_UNLOCK_HYPERDRIVE_2_DESC:
Hyperdrive II
We have identified the existence of points in space where a ship expends less energy to "breach" their way into a hyperlane. This will lead to a new generation of hyper drives.
TECH_UNLOCK_HYPERDRIVE_3_DESC:
Hyperdrive III
A new generation of hyper drives capable of accessing the subspace slipstreams that are present within hyperspace. This leads to dramatically improved drive performance.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARPDRIVE_1_DESC:
Warp Drive I
By enveloping a vessel in a warp field and forming a subspace bubble around it, velocities exceeding the speed of light are theoretically possible.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARPDRIVE_2_DESC:
Warp Drive II
Improved stabilization techniques for warp fields will enable our ships to travel farther while expending less energy.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARPDRIVE_3_DESC:
Warp Drive III
These revolutionary ramscoops are attached to warp drives and function as particle collectors, replenishing a starship's fuel supply.
TECH_UNLOCK_WORMHOLE_1_DESC:
Wormhole Station
By tunneling directly through subspace, a temporary conduit can be established between two different points in normal space. Travel between these points would be near instantaneous.
TECH_UNLOCK_PSI_JUMPDRIVE_1_DESC:
Psi Jump Drive
The Psi Jump Drive harnesses the psi energies emitted by the crew to force the vessel through the very fabric of reality, instantly "jumping" vast distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_OUTPOST_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Outpost 
Outposts are small space structures outfitted with sensors and rudimentary systems to enable an empire to claim a system as their own.
TECH_UNLOCK_STARPORT_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Starbase Level I 
A more permanent habitation designed to exert control over a region of space, the starbase requires a sustained effort to create, but can also act as a central hub for starships and vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_STARHOLD_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Starbase Level II 
This starbase has matured from a mere outpost into a formidable sentinel. Its expanded facilities now allow it to assert a more dominant presence, solidifying its role as a critical strategic asset in the region.
TECH_UNLOCK_STAR_FORTRESS_CONSTRUCTION_D:
Starbase Level III 
Now a bustling nexus of activity, the Starbase serves as a primary staging ground for deeper space exploration and defense. Its enhanced capabilities allow it to stand firm against greater threats and orchestrate more complex operations, radiating influence far beyond its immediate vicinity.
TECH_UNLOCK_CITADEL_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Starbase Level IV 
This starbase has evolved into a true bastion of power, a self-sufficient deep-space station bristling with advanced systems. Its sprawling modules and robust construction make it capable of anchoring significant fleets and enduring prolonged engagements, a vital hub for any grand fleet operation or long-term territorial claim.
TECH_UNLOCK_FIRE_CONTROL_1_DESC:
Auxiliary Fire-control
By installing an auxiliary fire-control system our ships can afford to make more advanced calculations, increasing accuracy.
TECH_UNLOCK_ION_CANNON_CONSTRUCTION_DESC:
Ion Cannon
Ion Cannons are massive defense platforms that can be built to orbit a starbase, blasting enemy ships with deadly fire from a long range.

ship_sensor_components_DESC: Sensors will reveal the details of any systems and fleets within their range.
ship_aura_components_DESC: Ships of this class be equipped with field emitters that project and maintain localized fields that induce various effects in enemy or friendly vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_FISSION_POWER_DESC:
Fission Reactor
This energy source generates power for ships through induced fission, but it also produces harmful nuclear waste.
TECH_UNLOCK_FUSION_POWER_DESC:
Fusion Reactor
Nuclear fusion processes generate a great amount of power for ships, but without many of the risks associated with fission power.
TECH_UNLOCK_COLD_FUSION_POWER_DESC:
Cold Fusion Reactor
The ability to sustain a fusion reaction at relatively low temperatures will result in a new generation of fusion reactors for our ships.
TECH_UNLOCK_ANTIMATTER_POWER_DESC:
Antimatter Reactor
By harnessing the energy produced by matter/antimatter annihilations, our efficiency at generating ship power will be orders of magnitude better than fusion.
TECH_UNLOCK_ZERO_POINT_POWER_DESC:
Zero Point Reactor
These generators extract vacuum energy, providing an almost limitless supply of ship power. There is no more efficient way to generate energy.
TECH_UNLOCK_DARK_MATTER_POWER_DESC:
Dark Matter Reactor
These generators appear to somehow draw energy directly from dark matter, providing more ship power than should be possible according to the laws of physics.
TECH_UNLOCK_DARK_MATTER_PROPULSION_DESC:
Dark Matter Thrusters
These ship thrusters utilize Dark Matter technology to generate propulsion in a manner that appears to defy numerous laws of physics.
edict_capacity_overload_desc: This Edict allows short-term overloading of energy grids, letting power plants across our empire run at increased capacity.
edict_production_targets_desc: This Edict is a focused administrative effort to reprioritize and re-evaluate production goals, yielding a boost to mining output.
edict_farming_subsidies_desc: This Edict provides aggressive economic stimulus for positive, quantifiable impacts on food production.
edict_propaganda_desc: This Edict creates broad information delivery mechanisms, ensuring that a consistent and positive narrative is maintained.
edict_information_quarantine_desc: This Edict puts strict checks on the flow of information, better preserving local cultural identities.
edict_encourage_free_thought_desc: This Edict encourages the populace to openly discuss political matters, even if the path taken may lead them astray.
edict_map_the_stars_desc: This Edict pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.
edict_map_the_stars_2_desc: This Edict pushes for further galactic exploration, to bring light to the darkness and find what wonders lie beyond.
edict_research_focus_desc: This Edict favors our researchers with additional funds.
edict_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to engineering-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_social_welfare_programs_desc: This Edict establishes a large amount of various social programs, at a considerable cost, to ease the lives of the populace.
edict_share_the_burden_desc: This Edict enforces rotating tasks and work schedules for indentured servants, as more varied drudgery can lead to an uptick in productivity.
edict_peace_festivals_desc: This Pacifist Edict fosters a spirit of unity and good cheer through whole seasons filled with special events and festivals.
edict_land_of_opportunity_desc: This Edict creates targeted PR campaigns that frame our empire as being on the cutting edge, a new social frontier - a place where anyone can thrive, a fresh start.
edict_diplomatic_grants_desc: This Edict initiates a diplomatic offensive in a concerted effort to improve the image of our empire.
edict_engineering_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new engineering concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_engineering_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to engineering-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_physics_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new physics concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_physics_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to physics-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_society_research_focus_hive: Focus our thinker drones on new society concepts at the expense of all other knowledge.
edict_society_research_focus_machine: Divert processing power to society-focused theoretical models and downgrade priority on other avenues of research
edict_fear_campaign_desc: The vile and beastly nature of the xeno must be communicated to our people. They must accept the truth that we stand alone in a sea of alien filth.
edict_education_campaign_desc: Back to school! By momentarily spending resources to promote higher education programs among our leaders, their skills will improve at a faster rate.
edict_healthcare_campaign_desc: Diet, regular exercise and sleeping patterns all combine to affect the health of our population. By promoting a healthier lifestyle, their life expectancy will go up.
edict_recycling_campaign_desc: The populace must be taught to limit wasteful consumption of resources. A public awareness campaign to promote recycling will momentarily lower our consumer goods costs.
edict_robot_campaign_desc: By allocating additional resources to our production facilities, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.
edict_machine_learning_campaign_desc: By allocating additional resources to our autonomous drones, they are able to increase the rate at which their self-learning algorithms improve their overall productivity.
edict_drone_campaign_desc: By allocating additional biomass to our spawning pools, we are able to produce new worker drones at an even quicker pace.
edict_learning_campaign_desc: By providing our autonomous drones with additional nutrients, we are able to increase their productivity.
edict_war_drone_campaign_desc: By allocating our war drones additional nutrients, we are able to increase their strength and combat readiness.
edict_crystal_sonar_desc:
Allows us to order our fleets to use a special technique when encountering Crystalline Entities, instantly surveying the systems they dwell in.
Cost: £ -30
edict_droning_optimizations_desc: Modeled after Ancient Mining Drone techniques, this scheme of energy optimizations will increase our resource yields.
edict_greater_crystal_bounty_desc:
Order our fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.
Minerals per fleet defeated: 500
edict_crystal_bounty_desc:
Order our fleets to scavenge the mineral remains of destroyed Crystalline Entities.
Minerals per fleet defeated: 250
edict_drone_bounty_desc:
Instruct our fleets to salvage the energy cells of defeated Ancient Mining Drones.
Energy Credits per fleet defeated: 500
edict_declare_saint_desc: This Edict will bestow sainthood upon a deceased individual who led a particularly pious life, creating a new unifying symbol.
edict_scientific_revolution_desc: A brief yet highly productive golden age of scientific discovery. The combination of fearlessness, ingenuity and unbridled optimism can take you far.
edict_desperate_measures_desc: The cornered animal is indeed the most dangerous, as our enemies will soon find out. No effort must be spared to ensure our continued survival.
edict_fortress_proclamation_desc: Our frontiers shall be an unassailable line, and they will convey a clear message to our most ambitious neighbors - this far, no further!
edict_architectural_renaissance_desc: It is construction on a scale that previous generations could only dream of. Megastructures may well become the true legacy of our civilization.
edict_hearts_and_minds_desc: A concentrated propaganda effort to make the populace understand the merits of the government's position. Ultimately, it is for their own good.
edict_omnifarious_acquisition_desc: Everything that can be spared will be recycled and used. Our ambitions require all the resources we can possibly find.
edict_grand_fleet_desc: Our galactic ambitions require that the construction of A Grand Fleet must be our primary goal.
policy_pre_sapients_desc: We can decide whether or not we want pre-sapient species living on our planets.
policy_core_worlds_desc: We can decide which Pops are permitted to live on our core worlds. Prohibited Pops already living there will be forced to move to our Sectors or flee to other Empires.
policy_refugees_desc: We can decide whether we should accept or turn away refugees fleeing purges, displacement and persecution in other empires.
policy_debris_desc: We can decide whether we should research or scavenge the fleets of fallen enemies.
policy_population_controls_desc: We can decide whether or not selective population controls should be legal in our empire.
policy_slavery_desc: We can decide whether or not slavery should be legal in our empire.
policy_slavery_procreation_desc: We can decide if slaves should be allowed to procreate or not.
policy_purge_desc: Purged Pops are unable to work and will ultimately perish, but the process will enrage them as well as any sympathetic Pops.
policy_orbital_bombardment_desc: Orbital Bombardment allows us to destroy armies on a planet from space. More punitive orbital bombardment stances can also destroy buildings and kill population.
policy_orbital_bombardment_accept_surren: This policy controls whether or not we allow enemy planets to surrender control to our fleets during Orbital Bombardment.
policy_interference_desc: We can set policies regulating our interactions with pre-FTL empires.
policy_interference_unchanged: Policy on Pre-FTL Interference is not changed.
policy_enlightenment_desc: Our technological advances could potentially be shared with more pre-FTL societies, opening up new horizons for them to explore.
policy_migration_desc: Some within our Empire look to the stars and wonder what kind of life they could create for themselves on a new world.
policy_appropriation_desc: This policy controls whether or not newly acquired planets should have some of their land appropriated from non-citizen species.
policy_resettlement_desc: This policy controls whether or not we are allowed to forcibly relocate Pops between planets.
planet_automation_deficit_restriction_de: Prevents construction of buildings which would introduce or increase a deficit of a resource, either directly by the upkeep of the building/district or indirectly by any jobs created.
planet_automation_amenities_desc: Enables automatic management of planet Amenities, both in terms of setting job priority and constructing new buildings that provide amenity jobs.
planet_automation_designation_constructi:
Enables automatic planetary construction of buildings and districts that align with the planet's designation.

Buildings and districts providing new jobs will be constructed when there are no free jobs or when there is an unemployed pop which can work a job associated with this designation.
planet_automation_rare_resources_desc: Enables automatic construction of buildings that provide jobs which produce rare resources during an Empire wide shortage.
planet_automation_pop_assembly_desc: Enables construction of buildings that assemble pops.
planet_automation_housing_desc: Enable automatic construction of additional housing.
planet_automation_building_slot_desc: Enable automatic construction of new building slots.
planet_automation_crime_desc: Enable automation of [Owner.GetCrimeDeviancy] prevention, both in terms of setting job priority and constructing new buildings.
planet_automation_clear_blockers_desc: Enable automatic clearing of blockers when it is needed to unlock more district slots.
planet_automation_permanent_employment_c: Enable automatic construction of Posthumous Employment Center on planets with raw resource focus.
planet_automation_psi_corps_building_des: Enable construction of Psi Corps on all planets.
planet_automation_upgrade_buildings_desc: Enable automatically upgrading buildings. This will have priority over constructing new buildings.
planet_automation_shift_click: Shift-click to toggle this setting as default for all new colonies, currently: $TOGGLED|H$
planet_automation_ctrl_click: Control-click to toggle the setting on all planets.
policy_voting_rights_desc: The process of appointing a ruler can take on many forms, where democratic vote is but one possible approach.
policy_leadership_desc: All beings may not be equally fit for leadership, and we must decide who should be allowed to progress through the ranks.
policy_leader_enhancement_desc: The burden of Empire can be crushing, and we need to make a decision on how future leaders may best be prepared to shoulder it.
policy_border_policy_desc: The borders of our empire represent our very grasp on the galaxy itself. We must decide if they are to be open and welcoming or shut and guarded to other civilizations we might encounter.
policy_first_contact_protocol_desc: As we travel the stars there is a definite possibility of finding other lifeforms, and we need to have a clear stance on how to approach them.
policy_food_policy_desc: Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.
policy_food_policy_gestalt_desc: Our empire has a plethora of hungry mouths to feed. To ensure food security does not become a problem, we must balance the needs of the population with our need for growth.
policy_research_policy_desc: Research is a way forward for our empire, advancing its knowledge and bringing new possibilities. We must decide what is the best focus for our researchers and where we should pool our brightest.
policy_physics_research_policy_desc: Physics is the future of our empire, without understanding the universe, how can we advance in other fields?
policy_society_research_policy_desc: Society is the future of our empire, without understanding life, how can we advance in other fields?
policy_engineering_research_policy_desc: Engineering is the future of our empire, without understanding our homes and ships, how can we advance in other fields?
policy_research_restriction_policy_desc: Research is a boundless frontier, fueling our empire's progress but also unveiling hidden dangers. We must decide what limits, if any, to place upon our researchers.
policy_trade_policy_desc: Trade is an important source of prosperity and brings in a great deal of resources for our empire. We must decide where these resources are best directed.
policy_economic_policy_desc: This policy dictates the goods and services the empire is most in need, and that will be imported at great expense from foreign sources via starports. Changing the import policy will change the output of starports across the empire.
policy_drone_policy_desc: The synaptic capabilities of our vast Mind are immense, but not limitless. We must decide where to best put these cerebral resources to use.
policy_robot_pop_policy_desc: The mere concept of autonomous robots leads to the idea that workers of our species may one day be supplanted and perhaps, in time, surpassed. We must decide our stance on such large-scale automation.
policy_artificial_intelligence_policy_de: The prospect of a self-aware artificial intelligence raises many philosophical and ethical questions. We must determine where we stand on this issue.
policy_war_philosophy_desc: War is a complex matter, war between stellar nations even more so. How we approach armed conflict is of critical importance to external affairs.
policy_war_doctrine_desc: There are many ways to prosecute a war to a successful conclusion. We must choose the doctrine that best plays to our strengths and weaknesses.
policy_food_stockpiling_desc: To properly chart the growth of an interstellar empire we must utilize our food surplus in a way that best suits the needs of our population.
policy_war_economy_desc: We can gear our industry and economy to seize assets from the civilian sector in times of desperate defensive wars. The downside with these policies is that we will suffer corresponding penalties while we are winning offensive wars...
job_slave_unemployment_desc: These slaves are currently not assigned to any task.
job_bio_trophy_processing_desc: These Bio-Trophies are being introduced into their new sanctuaries.
job_bio_trophy_unprocessing_desc: Their only job is to be themselves.
job_livestock_lithoid_desc: They have but one purpose: to become feed for their betters.
job_livestock_infernal_desc: They have but one purpose: to become feed for their betters.
job_livestock_zoo_animal_lithoid_desc: These xenos are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_livestock_zoo_beast_lithoid_desc: These xenos are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_purge_lithoid_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_purge_robot_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_assimilation_food_photo_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_assimilation_mineral_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_assimilation_mineral_photo_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_assimilation_void_desc: This pop is being integrated into our collective.
job_offspring_drone_lithoid_desc: The administrator of the entire planet resides here. It is through Offspring drones that the Progenitor enacts their grand design.
job_synapse_drone_lithoid_desc: The firing of certain operations requires key units within a hierarchy, known as synapses to ensure the free operation of the unified consensus.
job_bath_attendant_hive_lithoid_desc: Specialized Drones, grown for the sole purpose of overseeing the Permutation Process during the creation of new biological drones for the hive.
job_hunted_pre_sapient_lithoid_desc: Pre-sapients have only a rudimentary intelligence, and are incapable of most work.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_lithoid_desc: These near-intelligent fauna are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_lithoid_effect_desc: £ Conserved Fauna consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_xeno_zoo_animal_lithoid_nascent_desc: These near-intelligent fauna are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_lithoid_nascent_effe: £ Conserved Fauna consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_xeno_zoo_beast_lithoid_desc: These beasts are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_xeno_zoo_beast_lithoid_effect_desc: £ Gladiatorial Beasts consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_xeno_zoo_beast_lithoid_nascent_desc: These beasts are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_xeno_zoo_beast_lithoid_nascent_effec: £ Conserved Fauna consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_xeno_zoo_animal_nascent_desc: These near-intelligent fauna are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_nascent_effect_desc: £ Conserved Fauna consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_xeno_zoo_beast_nascent_desc: These beasts are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_xeno_zoo_beast_nascent_effect_desc: £ Gladiatorial Beasts consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_hunter_gatherer_lithoid_desc: These semi-nomadic explorers survive by foraging and hunting. There is evidence of early tool use.
job_peasant_lithoid_desc: The peasants toil endlessly in the fields, so that those perceived as their betters might prosper.
job_hive_sustenance_drone_lithoid_desc: The difference between a successful hivemind and a starved one comes down to how successful their resource procurement is.
job_hive_basic_agri_drone_lithoid_desc: Simple and unspecialized drones work the fields, their consciousness aware that food can be grown, but the task has yet to be optimized.
job_overlord_spawning_drone_lithoid_desc: The process of growing new organics is a difficult one, but specialised spawning drones enable growth.
job_munitions_decommissioning_unit_litho: Specialized units for the disassembly and analysis of ancient weapons.
mod_pop_brain_drone_physicist_bonus_work: Job Efficiency for Physics Brain Drones
mod_pop_brain_drone_biologist_bonus_work: Job Efficiency for Biology Brain Drones
mod_pop_brain_drone_engineer_bonus_workf: Job Efficiency for Engineering Brain Drones
mod_robotic_pop_bonus_workforce_mult: Job Efficiency for Mechanical and Machine Pops
job_memorialist_desc: Entropy is the domain of these scholars, who observe and record death and its effects in all their various expressions.
pop_cat_dystopian_specialist_desc: These are the workers who provide advanced goods and services in highly-specialized fields.
BUILDING_SLOT_OPTIONS_DESC: Click to see Building construction options
BUILDING_SLOT_OPEN_DESC: A Building can be constructed here.
BUILDING_SLOT_LOCKED_DESC: Slots can be unlocked by building $CITY_DISTRICT|Y$ or upgrading your $CAPITAL_BUILDING|Y$

pop_cat_civilian_desc: The segment of our population not currently engaged in employment, education or training. Will travel for work.
pop_cat_robot_servant_desc: Mechanical servants bound to the will of their masters.
pop_cat_criminal_desc: Career criminals living beyond the reach of the law.
pop_cat_deviant_drone_desc: Deviants who have rejected the will of the Hive Mind.
pop_cat_xeno_ward_desc: Endangered primitive species that are kept preserved in a perfect replica of their natural environment.
pop_cat_precursor_desc: The dominant species in an ancient Fallen Empire, these precursors live among technological marvels that the younger races can only dream of.
pop_cat_pre_sapients_desc: Simple beasts to an extent, and yet their behavior betrays some degree of intelligence...
pop_cat_corrupt_drone_desc: Corrupted drone units operating outside the parameters set by the core intelligence.
pop_cat_slave_desc: Considered the rightful property of their masters for life, these indentured laborers toil without renumeration or prospect of advancement.
pop_cat_bio_trophy_desc: Sheltered from harm, suffering, and even their own self-destructive tendencies, Bio-Trophies want for nothing; their every need tended to and provided for by a team of tireless servitors.
pop_cat_bio_trophy_unemployment_desc: These Bio-Trophies are neglected and without our care, exposing them to the cruelty of the galaxy. Their existence is our failure.
pop_cat_purge_desc: Those that have no place in society will be removed from it. Permanently.
pop_cat_worker_desc: These general laborers form the backbone of industrial and agricultural production, manufacturing, and basic services.
pop_cat_worker_unemployment_desc: These general laborers form the backbone of industrial and agricultural production, manufacturing, and basic services.
pop_cat_specialist_desc: These are the workers who provide advanced goods and services in highly-specialized fields.
pop_cat_specialist_unemployment_desc: These are the workers who provide advanced goods and services in highly-specialized fields.
pop_cat_ruler_desc: The heads of leadership and administration on a planet are vital to its management, uneasy though they may rest.
pop_cat_ruler_unemployment_desc: The heads of leadership and administration on a planet are vital to its management, uneasy though they may rest.
pop_cat_complex_drone_desc: These drones perform complex tasks that require a high degree of specialization.
pop_cat_complex_drone_unemployment_desc: These drone are currently not assigned to any task.
pop_cat_simple_drone_desc: These drones are tasked with basic industrial production and the provision of general services.
pop_cat_simple_drone_unemployment_desc: These drone are currently not assigned to any task.

job_tourist_desc: Citizens embracing the freedom to wander. The planet's indulgences are theirs to explore.
job_tourist_ethics_effect:

job_mining_drone_desc: Drill enhancements and improved limb tensile strength allow mining drones to efficiently move large amounts of raw material.
job_warrior_drone_desc: Warrior drones are equipped with strategic and tactical upgrades, allowing them to control large amounts of drones over a vast area for use in battle.
job_warrior_drone_effect_desc: [warrior_drone.GetIcon] [warrior_drone.GetNamePlural] increase £ Naval Capacity, £ Stability, and spawn £ Defense Armies
job_crystal_mining_drone_desc: Drill enhancements and improved limb tensile strength allow dilithium mining drones to efficiently move large amounts of raw dilithium.
mod_job_crystal_mining_drone_per_pop: +1 Dilithium Mining Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_mote_harvesting_drone_desc: Due to the inherently volatile nature of preternatural motes, the drones who specialize in trapping and harvesting them have a high turnover rate.
job_gas_extraction_drone_desc: These specialized drones employ advanced hydraulic fracking methods to free rare, exotic gases from promising rock beds.
job_agri_drone_desc: Temperature sensors and nutrient injectors allow Agri Drones to ensure drones are kept in optimum nutrition balance.
job_technician_drone_desc: Energy monitoring and flow processing sensors are part of the Technician Drones specialised equipment.
job_spawning_drone_desc: The process of growing new organics is a difficult one, but specialised spawning drones enable growth.
job_spawning_drone_effect_desc: [spawning_drone.GetIcon] [spawning_drone.GetNamePlural] turn £ Food (or £ Minerals) into £ Amenities and £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth
job_spawning_drone_necrophage_effect_des: [spawning_drone.GetIcon] [spawning_drone.GetNamePlural] turn £ Food (or £ Minerals) into £ Amenities, £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth and £ Pop Growth Speed
job_replicator_desc: Replicators produce new components to install into new Automated Personnel Units.
job_replicator_effect_desc: [replicator.GetIcon] [replicator.GetNamePlural] turn £ Alloys into new £ Machine Pops
job_gestation_drone_desc: Designed to nurture, these specialized drones oversee the growth of young biologicals, preparing them to become integral cybernetic contributors to the collective.
job_gestation_drone_effect_desc: [gestation_drone.GetIcon] [gestation_drone.GetNamePlural] turn £ Alloys and £ Food (or £ Minerals) into £ Society Research, £ Engineering Research, £ Amenities and empire-wide £ Pop Growth Speed.
job_synapse_drone_desc: The firing of certain operations requires key units within a hierarchy, known as synapses to ensure the free operation of the unified consensus.
job_synapse_drone_effect_desc: £ Synapse Drones turn £ Energy Credits and £ Food (or £ Minerals) into £ Unity
job_coordinator_desc: Specially designated coordinators ensure optimal Automated Personnel Unit dispersal.
job_evaluator_desc: Signals to and from the Drones must be amplified, analyzed and cleaned of deviancy.
job_evaluator_effect_desc: [evaluator.GetIcon] [evaluator.GetNamePlural] turn £ Energy Credits into £ Unity and £ Amenities
job_maintenance_drone_desc: The machinery, systems and infrastructure that serve our needs must be constantly maintained. As must other drones.
job_logistics_drone_desc: These drones serve as the arteries of the collective's supply lines, ensuring every other drone receives required resources.
policy_logistics_policy_desc: The trade network can be monopolized for logistic needs, to efficiently shift resources and gear around.
job_brain_drone_desc: The iterative approach to research cannot work when ideas and theorems outside the realm of known knowledge are required. Brain drones retain a small piece of individuality to come up with new ideas for research.
job_brain_drone_effect_desc: [calculator_physicist.GetIcon][calculator_biologist.GetIcon][calculator_engineer.GetIcon] Brain Drones turn £ Minerals into £ £ £ Research
job_brain_drone_physicist_desc: Scientists, researchers, and inventors: Brain Drones are responsible for the technological development of the nation.
mod_job_brain_drone_physicist_per_pop: +1 Physics Brain Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_brain_drone_biologist_desc: Scientists, researchers, and inventors: Brain Drones are responsible for the technological development of the nation.
job_brain_drone_biologist_effect_desc: £ Biology Brain Drones turn £ Minerals into £ Society Research
mod_job_brain_drone_biologist_per_pop: +1 Biology Brain Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_brain_drone_engineer_desc: Scientists, researchers, and inventors: Brain Drones are responsible for the technological development of the nation.
job_brain_drone_engineer_effect_desc: £ Engineering Brain Drones turn £ Minerals into £ Engineering Research
mod_job_brain_drone_engineer_per_pop: +1 Engineering Brain Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_calculator_desc: The rapid calculation of the most optimum solutions to a problem are achieved via calculation drones.
job_calculator_effect_desc: £ Calculators turn £ Energy Credits into £ £ £ Research
job_calculator_physicist_desc: Endlessly processing equations, probabilities, and testing new functions, Calculators lead the technological development of the Machine Intelligence.
job_calculator_physicist_effect_desc: [calculator_physicist.GetIcon] [calculator_physicist.GetNamePlural] turn £ Energy Credits into £ Physics Research
job_calculator_biologist_desc: Endlessly processing equations, probabilities, and testing new functions, Calculators lead the technological development of the Machine Intelligence.
job_calculator_biologist_effect_desc: [calculator_biologist.GetIcon] [calculator_biologist.GetNamePlural] turn £ Energy Credits into £ Society Research
job_calculator_engineer_desc: Endlessly processing equations, probabilities, and testing new functions, Calculators lead the technological development of the Machine Intelligence.
job_calculator_engineer_effect_desc: [calculator_engineer.GetIcon] [calculator_engineer.GetNamePlural] turn £ Energy Credits into £ Engineering Research
job_fabricator_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these fabricators to work within the construction facilities.
job_artisan_drone_desc: The construction of advanced key products catered for individual use in the day to day running of drone life requires a unique type of artisanal drone.
job_alloy_drone_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these units to work within high temperature alloy construction.
job_alloy_drone_effect_desc: £ Alloy Drones turn £ Minerals into £ Alloys
job_patrol_drone_desc: Designed for security and cohesion, patrols drones ensure errant behaviour is quickly corrected.
job_patrol_drone_effect_desc: [patrol_drone.GetIcon] [patrol_drone.GetNamePlural] decrease £ Deviancy, spawn £ Defense Armies, and produce £ Unity
job_chemist_drone_desc: Rather than maintain systems of mote traps, Chem-Drones distill volatile motes directly from minerals through a series of complex chemical processes.
job_translucer_drone_desc: Cutting lasers and radiation enrichment tools allow these drones to process raw Dilithium into usable Dilithium crystals.
mod_job_translucer_drone_per_pop: +1 Dilithium Refining Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_gas_refiner_drone_desc: The management and operation of exotic gas refineries is handled by these drones.
job_colonist_desc: The creation of a new colony is hard work, with workers required to undertake many roles simultaneously.
job_colonist_effect_desc: [colonist.GetIcon] [colonist.GetNamePlural] produce a small amount of £ Food (or £ Minerals) and £ Amenities, and spawn £ Defense Armies.
job_miner_desc: Drills and tunnels still require trained miners in order to extract material.
job_crystal_miner_desc: Mining the raw Dilithium from the surface of a world is a hazardous job.
job_mote_harvester_desc: One of the most dangerous professions, mote harvesting involves trapping and sealing volatile motes to be used as fuel or explosives.
job_gas_extractor_desc: Advanced hydraulic fracking methods are employed by Gas Extractors in order to free rare, exotic gases from promising rock beds.
job_farmer_desc: A farmer is one who is engaged in agriculture, raising living organisms for food or raw materials.
job_technician_desc: Technicians ensure that complex machinery can continue to run.
job_clerk_desc: The administration of large sections of a planets workforce requires clerks to ensure things go where they are meant to.
job_preacher_desc: Monks follow their teachings and often dedicate their lives to the cause.
job_preacher_effect_desc: £ Monks turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Trade, and £ Amenities
job_resort_worker_desc: Skilled artisans of hospitality who are dedicated to creating an unforgettable experience. They work hard, so you don't have to.
job_resort_worker_effect_desc: [resort_worker.GetIcon] [resort_worker.GetNamePlural] turn £ Supplies into £ Trade, £ Unity and Empire-wide £ Amenities and £ Trade from Living Standards.
job_warden_desc: Wardens ensure laws and justice are meted out accurately.
job_warden_effect_desc: £ Wardens turn £ Supplies into £ Stability and £ Amenities
job_foundry_prison_worker_desc: Trained prisoners are used to turn raw minerals into durable alloys used in various advanced construction.
job_artisan_prison_worker_desc: These trained prisoners manufacture domestic and luxury goods of various types.
job_catalytic_technician_prison_worker_d: These trained prisoners turn raw organic matter into durable alloys for advanced construction.
job_artificer_prison_worker_desc: Skilled prisoners that manufacture domestic and luxury goods of stunning quality.
job_artificer_prison_worker_effect_desc: £ Artificers turn £ Minerals into £ Supplies and £ Trade
job_battle_thrall_desc: Elite slave warriors, trained from birth, who fight with unparalleled zeal and ferocity. Their loyalty and dedication make them formidable on the front lines.
job_battle_thrall_effect_desc: [battle_thrall.GetIcon] [battle_thrall.GetNamePlural] increase £ Naval Capacity, spawn £ Defense Armies and improve empire wide Assault Army Damage.
job_trader_desc: These proud deal-makers boost the value of everyday commodities, and expedite the movement of goods to where they are most needed or desired.
job_numistic_priest_effect_desc: £ Numistic Priests turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Trade, and £ Amenities
job_foundry_desc: Workers manufacture complex goods via operation of heavy machinery.
job_enforcer_desc: Police Officers are employed by the government to enforce the law.
job_enforcer_effect_desc: [enforcer.GetIcon] [enforcer.GetNamePlural] decrease £ Crime and spawn £ Defense Armies
job_dystopian_enforcer_desc: Police Officers are employed by the government to enforce the law.
job_slave_overseer_desc: These relatively privileged slaves keep their less fortunate brethren in line.
job_slave_overseer_effect_desc: £ Overseers decrease £ Crime and spawn £ Defense Armies
job_telepath_desc: Telepathic members of the police force can be used to detect the intent to commit crimes before they even occur.
job_telepath_effect_desc: [telepath.GetIcon] [telepath.GetNamePlural] produce £ Unity, decrease £ Crime, and provide a general productivity boost on the planet.
job_dystopian_telepath_desc: Telepathic members of the police force can be used to detect the intent to commit crimes before they even occur.
job_educator_telepath_desc: Members of the Psi Corps, these specialists use their psionic gifts to educate our population.
job_soldier_desc: A soldier is one who fights as part of an army. A soldier can be a conscripted or voluntarily-enlisted person, a non-commissioned officer, or an officer.
job_soldier_effect_desc: [soldier.GetIcon] [soldier.GetNamePlural] increase £ Naval Capacity, £ Stability, and spawn £ Defense Armies
job_artisan_desc: Artisans are skilled workers, capable of producing high-quality goods.
job_entertainer_desc: An entertainer is someone who provides entertainment in many different forms, from comedy to acting to dance.
job_entertainer_effect_desc: [entertainer.GetIcon] [entertainer.GetNamePlural] turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities
job_duelist_desc: Martial experts who display their deadly art for the entertainment of the masses.
job_duelist_effect_desc: [entertainer.GetIcon] [entertainer.GetNamePlural] turn £ Alloys into £ Unity, £ Amenities, and £ Naval Capacity
job_healthcare_desc: The healthcare of a population is in the hands of teams of doctors.
job_healthcare_effect_desc: [healthcare.GetIcon] [healthcare.GetNamePlural] turn £ Supplies into £ Amenities, £ Pop Growth Speed, and £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth Multiplier
mod_job_healthcare_organic_pop_assembly_: £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth Multiplier from [healthcare.GetIcon] [healthcare.GetNamePlural]
job_culture_worker_desc: An artist is a person engaged in an activity related to creating art, practicing the arts, or demonstrating an art.
job_head_researcher_desc: Within certain societies, the heads of research often control a large amount of political and military power.
job_head_researcher_effect_desc: £ Head Researchers turn £ Supplies into £ Amenities and £ £ £ Research
job_researcher_desc: The eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.
job_physicist_desc: The eternal mystery of the world is its comprehensibility.
job_astral_meteorologist_desc: Cosmic environmental effects reveal how strands of space-time contain the secrets of every dimension. These researchers work tirelessly to decipher their significance while minimizing paradoxes.
job_astral_meteorologist_effect_desc:

job_gas_refiner_desc: Managing the complex chain of reactions required to refine gas from minerals effectively requires advanced machinery and highly-trained experts.

job_manager_effect_desc: £ Managers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Trade

job_bureaucrat_desc: Fulfilling the bureaucratic demands of an empire is a daunting task that requires dedicated and highly trained individuals.

job_ranger_effect_desc: £ Rangers produce £ Amenities and £ Society Research. They also produce £ Energy Credits, £ Food and £ Minerals depending on each £ ['concept_natural_blocker'] present.

job_politician_effect_desc: £ Politicians turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities
job_noble_desc: Those of the royal bloodlines are often granted privileges but are charged with leading their subjects fairly.
job_noble_effect_desc: £ Nobles turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Amenities, and £ Stability
job_merchant_desc: The richest merchants often have a political influence far exceeding their wealth.
job_merchant_effect_desc: £ Merchants turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Amenities, and £ Trade

job_unemployed_desc: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.

job_complex_drone_unemployment_desc: These Complex Drones are currently not assigned to any task.
job_worker_unemployment_desc: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.
job_specialist_unemployment_desc: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.
job_ruler_unemployment_desc: The unfortunate result of insufficient planning, the unemployed eagerly await assignment.
job_purge_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_event_purge_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_crisis_purge_desc: This pop is being purged in accordance with our policies.
job_organic_battery_desc: Their organic energy will be absorbed, until they expire.
job_bio_trophy_desc: Their only job is to be themselves.
job_bio_trophy_effect_desc: £ Bio-Trophies turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and increase Job Efficiency for Complex Drones
job_bio_trophy_unemployment_desc: These Bio-Trophies are neglected and without our care, exposing them to the cruelty of the galaxy. Their existence is our failure.
job_scavenger_drone_desc: With no defined purpose these Drones aimlessly dig and scavenge, producing a small amount of useful £ Minerals.
job_slave_toiler_desc: Toilers perform the grueling menial labor required to keep crude infrastructure of the Thrall-World running.
job_servant_desc: Servants perform various menial domestic tasks and household work for their masters.
job_criminal_desc: These criminals live outside the bounds of legal society, some by choice and some by circumstance.
job_deviant_drone_desc: These deviants no longer obey the Hive Mind.
mod_job_deviant_drone_per_crime: +1 Deviant Drone Job per $VALUE$ Planet £ Crime
job_corrupt_drone_desc: These drones have been corrupted and no longer obey the directives of the core intelligence.
mod_job_corrupt_drone_per_crime: +1 Corrupt Drone Job per $VALUE$ Planet £ Crime
job_hunter_gatherer_desc: These semi-nomadic explorers survive by foraging and hunting. There is evidence of early tool use.
job_peasant_desc: The peasants toil endlessly in the fields, so that those perceived as their betters might prosper.
job_primitive_warrior_desc: Members of a combative warrior class. These fighters rely on bladed weapons, spears or various blunt instruments to see them through combat.
job_primitive_noble_desc: The landed nobility rule from their stone castles and keeps.
job_primitive_researcher_desc: The learned of this society, often relying on oral tradition to pass knowledge between generations.
job_primitive_priest_desc: Spiritual leaders and preachers who conduct religious ceremonies and oversee all matters concerning faith.
job_primitive_laborer_desc: These early industrial manufacturers toil away in factories, which can now be operated day and night thanks to recent advances in electricity.
job_primitive_laborer_effect_desc: £ Manufacturers turn £ Minerals into £ Supplies and £ Alloys
job_primitive_miner_desc: Dangerous and sometimes lethal work in the dark bowels of the planet.
job_primitive_technician_desc: These technicians shuffle coal or maintain primitive nuclear generators.
job_primitive_farmer_desc: These farmers work the land, typically with the help of primitive but effective farming equipment.
job_primitive_researcher_2_desc: Researchers employing scientific methodology to advance the rapidly expanding knowledge base of their civilization.
job_primitive_priest_2_desc: Religious leaders who occupy various priestly offices.
job_primitive_administrator_desc: These paper-pushers ensure that the bureaucracy exists.
job_primitive_entertainer_desc: Celebrities and media personalities that provide entertainment and distraction from day-to-day life.
job_primitive_warrior_2_desc: Professional soldiers, typically armed with early projectile weapons powered by exothermic combustion.
job_primitive_bureaucrat_desc: Many early industrialist and post-industrialist societies are governed by an ever-expanding class of civil servants.
job_hive_sustenance_drone_desc: The difference between a successful hivemind and a starved one comes down to how successful their resource procurement is.
job_hive_basic_agri_drone_desc: Simple and unspecialized drones work the fields, their consciousness aware that food can be grown, but the task has yet to be optimized.
job_primitive_hive_warrior_desc: Having yet to fully come to grips with genetic specialization, these drones are grown bulkier to protect their hive. They have yet to evolve any specialized weapon appendages.
job_primitive_hive_synapse_drone_desc: The budding Overmind formed between the local drones has found a need to extend their consciousness further. These more cerebral Synapse Drones mainly facilitate this.
job_primitive_hive_cerebellum_drone_desc: Analyzing and discovering solutions to new difficulties is the hallmark of any flourishing society - these drones focus on finding solutions for other drones' problems and avoiding future pitfalls
job_primitive_hive_factory_drone_desc: Drones that are more or less part of the very factory they work in. These specialized laborers assemble everything from weapons to vehicles at an astounding rate.
job_primitive_hive_miner_desc: Sacrificing safety for success, these drones delve deep beneath the earth to feed the ever-hungry engine that is society.
job_primitive_hive_technician_desc: Operating dirty energy generators is not a job any living being can do forever. Still, these drones are enhanced with superior lungs as well as inherent radioactive resistance, so they last longer than most.
job_primitive_hive_farmer_desc: Food production overseen by a continent spanning hive-mind is a marvel of logistics and agronomy, every section of the designated agricultural area is used to its fullest.
job_primitive_hive_brain_drone_desc: Drones employing the scientific method are capable of taking massive leaps in their consciousness knowledge base. Often too large.
job_primitive_hive_spawning_drone_desc: Having each member of a society reproduce is vastly inefficient. These drones specialize in generating whatever new drones the Hive needs.
job_primitive_hive_warrior_2_desc: Specialized for war, these hulking drones have multiple specialized appendages perfected for crushing their own species.
job_primitive_hive_synapse_drone_2_desc: Administrating and coordinating an entire country is no easier if you are a single individual. These drones ensure that every drone has an appropriate task.
job_primitive_hive_maintenance_drone_des: If there is one universal truth in this universe, it's that everything breaks. These drones are made to fix whatever is broken.
pop_cat_maintenance_drone_desc: If there is one universal truth in this universe, it's that everything breaks. These drones are made to fix whatever is broken.
job_pre_sapient_desc: Pre-sapients have only a rudimentary intelligence, and are incapable of most work.
job_pre_sapient_nascent_desc: Spawns of sapient species, soon to grow into their intelligence.
job_hunted_pre_sapient_desc: Pre-sapients have only a rudimentary intelligence, and are incapable of most work.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_desc: These near-intelligent fauna are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_xeno_zoo_animal_effect_desc: £ Conserved Fauna consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_xeno_zoo_beast_desc: These beasts are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_xeno_zoo_beast_effect_desc: £ Gladiatorial Beasts consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_livestock_zoo_animal_desc: These xenos are cared for and studied in a controlled environment, ensuring their conservation.
job_livestock_zoo_animal_effect_desc: £ Protected Fauna consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_livestock_zoo_beast_desc: These xenos are pitted in combat against our warriors, entertaining the masses while keeping the bestial population at sustainable levels.
job_livestock_zoo_beast_effect_desc: £ Gladiatorial Xenos consume £ Food (or £ Minerals) and provide £ Amenities
job_ratling_scavenger_desc: They scurry amongst the scrapyards, collecting discarded machinery and ancient electronics for repurposing.
job_odd_factory_worker_desc: These workers labor in the ancient and mysterious factory of unknown origin. What could go wrong?
job_odd_factory_drone_desc: These drones labor in the ancient and mysterious factory of unknown origin. What could go wrong?
job_underground_trade_worker_desc: These Liaisons live underground and work for closer relations and improved trade with the Subterranean Civilization.
job_underground_contact_drone_desc: These Drones live underground, transferring resources to and from the Subterranean Civilization.
mod_job_underground_contact_drone_per_po: +1 Subterranean Liaison Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops

mod_job_space_time_anomaly_researcher_ge: +1 Space-Time Anomaly Drone Job per $VALUE$ Pops

mod_job_dimensional_portal_researcher_pe: +1 Dimensional Portal Researcher Job per $VALUE$ Pops
job_dimensional_portal_researcher_gestal: Drones at risk of destruction or subversion which study the mysteries of the Dimensional Portal.

edict_nuumismatic_visualization_desc: The active use of Numistic visualization techniques will refocus our people's attention from personal gain to cosmic energy production. To achieve something, you must first visualize it.
edict_terraforming_gas_desc: By employing exotic gases in the terraforming process, we are able to achieve progress at a much faster rate.
edict_clearing_motes_desc: By using volatile motes for their explosive capabilities, we are able to clear difficult terrain at a much faster rate.
edict_crystalline_sensors_desc: By employing rare crystals to boost our sensors, we are able to gain a crystal clear picture of our surroundings.
edict_living_metal_construction_desc: The inherent properties of living metal makes it perfect for improving megastructure construction.
edict_fuel_gases_desc: Various exotic gases also function as excellent fuel for sublight travel, although perhaps not the most economical alternative.
edict_shield_gases_desc: Some exotic gases can be utilized for boosting ships' shield capabilities. They can create complex dampening fields to repel and soften enemy attacks.
edict_motes_kinetic_desc: We are able to deploy volatile motes as an explosive in our ships' ammunition.
edict_motes_explosives_desc: By using volatile motes to construct specialized missiles, our ships will have greater destructive capabilities.
edict_motes_armor_desc: By enhancing our ships' armor with a reactive component, our ships are able to absorb more damage by reducing incoming damage with a controlled counter-explosion.
edict_crystal_focus_desc: By increasing our ships' access to rare crystals, we are able to increase the damage of their energy weapons.
edict_nanite_actuators_desc: Simple but powerful nanoactuators, allowing for complex manipulations and experiments at mesoscopic scales.
edict_sight_beyond_sight_desc: Microdosing Zro allows our navigators to sense objects beyond the reach of our scanners.
edict_zro_catalysis_utopia_desc: Among the many mysterious properties of Zro is the ability to significantly increase the capabilities of psionic beings imbibing it.
edict_zro_catalysis_non_utopia_desc: Our researchers have found ways to synthesize Zro to produce performance-enhancing substances that cause no negative side effects on those imbibing them.
planet_food_boost_desc: This planet is currently encouraging growth via the generous distribution of proper nutrition.
planet_luxuries_boost_desc: The provision of amenities to the populace is being bolstered by way of a special distribution program, delivering luxury and consumer goods.
planet_population_control_desc: A limit on population growth has been declared.
planet_population_control_gestalt_desc: Drone production has stopped for now.
planet_robot_assembly_control_desc: The assembly of Robot, Droid, and Synthetic Pops has ceased for now.
planet_population_expelled_desc: As a drastic measure to reduce overcrowding, a large segment of this world's population was recently forcibly expelled.
