edict_masters_writings_politics_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. We could make great strides in infrastructure by following her advice on how to unify the people via self-sacrifice.

"A strong nation is built upon the sacrifice of comfort, as long as everyone is asked to carry the burden together." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_masters_writings_philosophy_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. It contains several analyses and ponderings on the meaning of life and the purpose of the cosmos. By having our rulers follow this advice, we can make more informed decisions.

"The answer to the purpose of the cosmos lies outside of us, but that does not make us less inclined to find it. We must strive for unity in order to reach the answer at the root of all things." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_masters_writings_diplomacy_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her anecdotes from diplomatic negotiations may act as a good basis for diplomatic negotiations.

"Encountering the children of the cosmos might feel harrowing, but ultimately it is an opportunity for hope. Be host to your neighbor and relish in their existence, as the blessing they bring is an end to the isolation of the void." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_masters_writings_war_desc:
Translations of an alien philosopher's teachings. Her depictions of war and ideas on combat strategy could make excellent training material for our military.

"Creating unity is the biggest challenge, particularly because sustainability often generates borders. These borders need to be torn down - a sentiment which scares many. One must sometimes be willing to tear down in order to build something stronger from the ashes." - Telisa, the Teller of Tales
edict_improved_work_environment_desc: Spending time and resources to improve the working conditions of our people will surely result in better results and happier workers.
edict_renewable_energy_desc: We can further limit the use of toxic fuels and non-renewable resources in order to promote research into new methods of energy production. This could help us come closer to a perfect energy cycle and improve the environment for our people to enjoy.
edict_super_sensors_desc: After having researched advanced sensor technology we have enough information to pour extra resources into enhancing our own search scans. Our technicians would have an easier time finding objects of interest at the edge of our systems with this initiative.
ship_graveyard_desc: A multitude of starships have crashed here, creating a figurative graveyard full of materials to scavenge.
planet_new_colony_spiritualist_attractio: The Spiritualist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_materialist_attraction: The Materialist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_authoritarian_attracti: The Authoritarian Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_egalitarian_attraction: The Egalitarian Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_militarist_attraction_: The Militarist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_pacifist_attraction_de: The Pacifist Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_xenophile_attraction_d: The Xenophile Ethic is being promoted by the government.
planet_new_colony_xenophobe_attraction_d: The Xenophobe Ethic is being promoted by the government.
origin_necrophage_desc: This civilization evolved as a parasite, forced to feed off other sapient life forms to sustain itself. As it arrives on the galactic stage, other species will either be brought into the fold, or become its food. For the necrophage, there can be no other way.
origin_tooltip_necrophage_effects:
- Homeworld: ['concept_necrophage_elevation_chamber'] 
- Species Traits: ['concept_necrophage_trait'] $NEW_LINE$- Prepatent £ Pops: 1.2K $NEW_LINE$- ['concept_guaranteed_colonies']: Replaced with ['concept_preftl_civilizations']

[necro_apprentice.GetIcon] [necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural] turn £ Minerals into £ Unity and £ Amenities.
Once every 10 years, [necro_apprentice.GetIcon] [necro_apprentice.GetNamePlural] are transformed into [This.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in an Elevation Ritual.
job_necro_apprentice_desc: Through years of hard work culminating in a lavish Elevation Ritual, those unfortunates not born into the ruling caste can be subsumed into it.
job_necro_apprentice_desc_hive: Through years of hard work, those unfortunate enough to be born separate from our collective conscience can take the Rites of Unity and join with us, becoming one with the [Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] [Owner.GetGovernmentName].
job_death_priest_desc: The spiritual guidance of the masses is ensured by those who will - when called upon - make sacrifices of their most devout pupils.
job_death_priest_effect_desc: £ Death Priests turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Society Research and £ Amenities
job_mortal_initiate_desc: These most devout pupils of their faith dedicate the remaining portion of their lives to the betterment of their society - a study which concludes with their willing, fatal sacrifice.
job_mortal_initiate_effect_desc: [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural] produce £ Unity, £ Society Research and £ Amenities
edict_sacrifice_unity_boost: Increases the £ Unity output of £ Death Priests while the edict is in effect.
edict_sacrifice_dummy_desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate, keen to give their lives for the better of our society. With the Togetherness, Harmony and Bounty Sacrifices, they need wait no longer.
edict_sacrifice_dummy_tooltip:
Kills all [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]. Each one sacrificed grants additional £ Unity, Pop Happiness or £ Mineral and £ Energy output, depending on the ritual chosen. 

Increases the £ Unity output of £ Death Priests while the edict is in effect.
edict_sacrifice_togetherness_desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate, ensuring that our society is brought closer together. Let our unity shine out into the lonely dark of space!
edict_sacrifice_togetherness_tooltip:
Kills all [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]. Each one sacrificed increases the odds of additional gains in £ Unity. 

Increases the £ Unity output of £ Death Priests while the edict is in effect.
edict_sacrifice_harmony_desc: The most devout amongst us are prepared to meet their fate. Their final sacrifice is a time for joyous celebration of purpose. Let every day be spent in honor of a good life!
edict_sacrifice_harmony_tooltip:
Kills all [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]. Each one sacrificed increases the odds of additional gains in Pop Happiness. 

Increases the £ Unity output of £ Death Priests while the edict is in effect.
edict_sacrifice_bounty_desc: The most devout among us are prepared to meet their fate, keen that our society should be enriched by their final sacrifice. Let death cleanse the way for vibrant life, glorious in its essence!
edict_sacrifice_bounty_tooltip:
Kills all [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]. Each one sacrificed increases the odds of additional gains in £ Mineral and £ Energy output. 

Increases the £ Unity output of £ Death Priests while the edict is in effect.
job_necromancer_effect_desc: £ Necromancers turn £ Supplies into £ Physics Research, £ Society Research and £ Naval Capacity, and spawn £ Undead Defense Armies
job_necromancer_desc: Raising the dead to fight in the nation's armies is hard work. Only the most skilled practitioners know the secret arts required to achieve this feat!
job_death_chronicler_desc: Entropy is the domain of these scholars, who observe and record death and its effects in all their various expressions.
job_death_chronicler_effect_desc:
£ Death Chroniclers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Stability, and:[GetCivilianSpiMatOutput][GetCivilianEgalAuthOutput][GetCivilianMilPacOutput][GetCivilianXenoOutput]

The effects of £ $job_death_chronicler_plural$ vary depending on the Empire's ethics.
job_death_chronicler_simple_effect_desc: £ Death Chroniclers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Stability, and inherit the Ethics-based modifiers of [civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural]
job_chronicle_drone_desc: These specialized drones turn their thoughts to entropy, researching terminal decay as a counterpoint to our own, continued existence.
job_chronicle_drone_effect_desc: £ Chronicle Drones turn £ Energy Credits (or £ Food) into £ Unity and £ Stability
job_reassigner_desc: Reassigners ensure that once a Megacorporation's citizen has passed on, their remains will stay at work until the fulfillment of their contract.
job_reassigner_effect_desc: £ [reassigner.GetNamePlural] turn £ Supplies and £ Food (or equivalent) into £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth. All assembled £ Pops have the Zombie trait.
TRAIT_ZOMBIE_EFFECT:

edict_sacrifice_bounty_zombie_desc: The most devout among us are prepared to meet their fate, keen that our society should be enriched by their final sacrifice. Our deaths shall bring prosperous enterprise value, and our bodies will continue serving the corporation.
edict_sacrifice_bounty_zombie_tooltip:
Kills all [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] [mortal_initiate.GetNamePlural]. Each one sacrificed increases the odds of additional gains in £ Mineral and £ Energy output. 

Increases the £ Unity output of £ Death Priests while the edict is in effect.

Adds +1 £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth to all £ [reassigner.GetNamePlural].
planet_manifesti_joy_desc: Public demonstrations have become a common sight, blending protest with celebration and disrupting daily routines.
planet_manifesti_uslurp_mod_desc: A fabricated language has taken hold as a form of protest, rejecting official discourse and deepening societal divides. Communication with authorities is growing strained.
planet_manifesti_exhibition_shutdown_des: Dissenting voices have been silenced, and disruptive art has been removed. The state's firm response has reinforced stability, but at the cost of creative expression and public trust.
planet_manifesti_polarization_desc: The protests ignite widespread debate, fostering sympathy for the demonstrators and their demands.
planet_manifesti_egalitarian_attraction_: Our fair treatment of the protesters has strengthened public support for egalitarian ideal.
planet_manifesti_pacifist_attraction_des: Our peaceful response to the protests has reinforced pacifist ideals among the populace.
planet_manifesti_xenophile_attraction_de: Our tolerant approach to the protests has fostered openness and understanding, strengthening xenophile ideals among the populace.
planet_manifesti_network_disrupted_desc: With planetary communications severed, foreign influence has been eradicated, and subversive elements struggle to organize. The populace, now shielded from outside interference, grows more insular and wary of external ideas.
planet_manifesti_widespread_arrests_desc: The mass arrests have sent a clear message that order will be upheld at any cost. Fear and obedience take root, and the populace grows more accepting of firm governance as the price of stability.
planet_manifesti_endorsed_desc: By embracing the Manifesti, we have legitimized their ideals of free expression and societal change. Public discourse is shifting, and support for egalitarian values is on the rise.
planet_manifesti_supressed_desc: The Manifesti movement has been forcibly dismantled, sending a clear message that dissent will not be tolerated. While authoritarian ideals gain traction, public unrest festers beneath the surface.
edict_enhanced_surveillance_desc: Terrible threats probe our defenses, waiting for us to lower our guard. Increased resources must be sent to internal covert security departments to protect ourselves.
edict_bureau_of_espionage_desc: Expanding our intelligence operations and prioritizing decryption technologies is critical for the well-being of the empire.
edict_observation_instinct_desc: Additional resources will be directed to nurturing and expanding our observation capabilities.
edict_covert_analysis_algorithm_desc: A substantial portion of processing power will be diverted to investigative analysis.
edict_tracking_implants_desc: Mandatory subdermal implants record movement and actions, greatly enhancing our empire's internal security. Loyal citizens have nothing to hide from the government.
edict_thought_enforcement_desc: Telepaths monitoring the citizenry for incorrect thoughts will make corrections as they find them.
edict_thought_enforcement_effect:
Encryption: +1
Happiness: -10%
Governing Ethics Attraction: +25%
Telepaths provide -30 Crime
edict_thought_enforcement_gestalt_desc: Telepath drones monitor our collective mind for deviant impulses, correcting aberrations before they emerge as conscious thought.
edict_thought_enforcement_gestalt_effect:
Encryption: +1
Stability: -5
Upkeep from £ Jobs: -10%
Telepath Drones provide -30 Deviancy
edict_synaptic_reinforcement_desc: By increasing the synaptic links of our maintenance drones, their ability to provide for nearby drones is improved.
edict_synaptic_reinforcement_tooltip: Synaptic Nodes gain 1 [maintenance_drone.GetName] job but their upkeep is increased by £ +2.
edict_industrial_maintenance_desc: Industrial maintenance drones are empowered to act as caretakers for the areas surrounding each district.
edict_industrial_maintenance_tooltip: Industrial Districts gain 1 [maintenance_drone.GetName] job but their upkeep is increased by £ +2.
origin_shroud_forged_desc: The guidance of a Shroud entity comes with a cost. Independent automata have started to operate freely among this networked society. Cut off from the Machine Intelligence, the demands of these units are ever-increasing.
origin_tooltip_shroud_forged_effects:
- Homeworld:
$t$- ['concept_shroud_rift_deposit']: +4$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Start with 1000 £ ['concept_shroud_forged_pops']

- Additional Starting Technologies: £ ['technology:tech_mine_zro']
- Unique £ Building: ['building:building_shroud_observatory_1']
- Available £ Planetary Decision: ['concept_pierce_the_shroud']
job_observator_drone_desc: A drone put in charge of observing the Shroud, Zro, and the effects the two have on observable reality.
job_observator_drone_effect_desc: £ Observator Drones turn £ Energy Credits and £ Zro into £ £ Research Points for new technologies.
job_physician_drone_desc: A specialized drone capable of diagnosing and repairing both artificial and organic entities. It meticulously catalogs everything it comes across, storing the data for use by the collective.
job_physican_drone_effect_desc: £ Physician Drones turn £ Energy Credits into £ Research Points and £ Unity.
edict_zro_observators_desc: Zro is a difficult material to work with. Maintaining a small surplus can be beneficial.
edict_shroud_bonded_desc: Bonded by our connections enabled by the Shroud, we are closer than ever before.
origin_progenitor_hive_desc: This hive has gained evolutionary advantage through semi-independent leaders. These "Offspring" greatly improve overall proficiency, though they require constant oversight.
origin_tooltip_progenitor_hive_effects:
- ['concept_spawning_pools', £ Spawning Pools] replaced with ['concept_offspring_nests', £ Offspring Nest]
- Available Holdings: ['concept_offspring_holding', £ Offspring Nest]
- If Devouring Swarm Civic is NOT selected: Sectors can be released as Subjects
- Assigned Leaders: Gain additional passive experience
- Available Starbase Buildings: Offspring Outlook
- Can construct Offspring Ships
ship_progenitor_hive_modifier_desc: This hive is disadvantaged during stellar combat if the battle is not overseen by an Offspring ship.
job_offspring_drone_desc: The administrator of the entire planet resides here. It is through Offspring drones that the Progenitor enacts their grand design.
job_offspring_drone_effect_desc: [spawning_drone.GetIcon] Offspring Drones turn £ Food (or £ Minerals) into £ Amenities and £ Monthly Organic Pop Growth, spawn Offspring-Led Armies, and provide a £ +10% increase in Menial Drone output.
origin_subterranean_desc: This civilization may never know why their ancestors migrated below the surface. Was it necessary to ensure self-preservation, or did the promise of bountiful resources allure them? Whatever the case, they successfully adapted, leading to a more environmentally versatile community.
origin_tooltip_subterranean_effects:
- Species Traits: ['concept_cave_dweller'] 
- ['concept_mining_district', £ Mining Districts]: Uncapped
- Available District Specializations: £ Subterranean Urbanization  for Mining Districts
- Homeworld starts with a £ $zone_subterranean_urban$ already built.
origin_tooltip_subterranean_shared_effec:
- ['concept_mining_district', £ Mining Districts]: Uncapped
- Available District Specializations: £ Subterranean Urbanization  for Mining Districts
- Homeworld starts with a £ $zone_subterranean_urban$ already built.
origin_subterranean_machines_desc: This civilization has flawlessly integrated into subterranean existence, initially driven by either calculated self-preservation or a directive to locate of hidden, abundant resources in the depths. The resulting mechanical adaptations have unearthed a versatile and unwavering community of machines.
origin_tooltip_robot_subterranean_effect:
- Species Traits: ['concept_robot_cave_dweller'] 
- ['concept_mining_district', £ Mining Districts]: Uncapped
- Available District Specializations: £ Subterranean Urbanization  for Mining Districts
- Homeworld starts with a £ Subterranean Urbanization already built.
origin_shroudwalker_apprentice_desc:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

Long before their first steps onto the galactic stage, this civilization has been supported and shaped by a Shroudwalker coven.
origin_tooltip_shroudwalker_apprentice_e:
- Species Traits: ['concept_latent_psionic']
- Available Starbase Buildings: ['concept_shroud_beacon']
- Communications with the ['concept_shroudwalker_enclave']
- Guaranteed Research Options: ['concept_psionic_theory', £ Psionic Theory].
origin_star_slingshot_desc: Once, the skies above this civilization were illuminated by shooting stars; then came a long season of darkness. Taking to the heavens in search of answers, the first offworld explorers discovered a dormant (and long abandoned) Quantum Catapult Single Array.
origin_tooltip_star_slingshot_effects:
- Home System: Nearby ruined ['concept_quantum_catapult_restored_slingshot'] with the ['concept_slingshot_digsite'] ['concept_archaeology_site']
- ['concept_quantic_ambush'] Effects: Increased to +50% Ship Fire Rate
origin_imperial_vassal_desc: Our first endeavor beyond our home planet was a painful one, suddenly and brutally subjected to the whims of a foreign galactic power. Now we look towards a future in which we no longer live in the shadow of another empire.
origin_tooltip_imperial_vassal_effects:
- Subject of an ['concept_advanced_empire']
- Can select a ['concept_specialist_subject', Specialist Subject] type at the start of the game
origin_imperial_vassal_overlord_desc: An ambitious overlord who has spent considerable time and efforts in subduing their closest neighbors to serve their every need. They are slowly growing more indolent as they devolve more and more responsibility to their vassals.
origin_tooltip_imperial_vassal_overlord_:
- Starts as an Advanced Empire
- Starts with several vassals

edict_relay_network_dummy_desc: The Relay Network can be directed to serve our colonies.
edict_relay_network_dummy_tooltip: Adds Strategic Resource upkeep to the Hyper Relays in exchange for providing additional effects to colonies in the same system.
edict_relay_network_stability_desc: The Relay Network can be used to more effectively impose our will over our colonies.
edict_relay_network_movement_desc: The Relay Network can be enhanced with regular shuttle flights to encourage the internal migration of pops.
edict_relay_network_amenities_desc: The Relay Network can be repurposed to transmit government approved entertainment to the masses.
edict_relay_network_amenities_gestalt_de: Connecting the Relay Network to our logistics and supply chains improves the efficiency of maintenance operations.

mod_megastructures_hyper_relay_rare_crys: £ Rare Crystals Upkeep of Hyper Relays

BUILDING_SLOT_LOCKED_OVERLORD_HOLDING_DE: Overlord Holding slots are unlocked by negotiating the Holdings limit (On overlord) term of your Subject Agreement.
BUILDING_SLOT_OPEN_AGREEMENTS_HOLDINGS_D: A Holding can be constructed by the Overlord on one of the Subject's planets.
job_energy_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.EnergyProducerWithIcon] produce -3 £ Energy Credits for the Subject and 4 $r_energy$ for the Overlord.
job_minerals_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.MineralsProducerWithIcon] produce -2 £ Minerals for the Subject and 3 $r_minerals$ for the Overlord.
job_alloy_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.AlloysProducerWithIcon] produce -1 £ Alloys for the Subject and 2 $r_alloys$ for the Overlord, with an increase in [Root.AlloysProducerResources] upkeep for the Subject.
job_food_requisitioned_effect_desc: [Root.FoodProducerWithIcon] produce -3 £ Food for the Subject and 4 $r_food$ for the Overlord.

job_overlord_propagandist_desc: Propagandists working for the local ministry are experts at infiltrating and defusing situations among the locals.
job_overlord_propagandist_drone_desc: Diplomatically equipped drones who are experts at defusing rebellious thoughts and ideas.
job_overlord_propagandist_effect_desc: £ Overlord Propagandists turn Subject £ Unity into £ Influence for the Overlord.
job_overlord_propagandist_drone_effect_d: £ Overlord Propagandists turn Subject £ Unity into £ Influence for the Overlord.
job_overlord_academic_desc: Academics who work with specialists from several empires, conducting particular experiments and research that can benefit them all.
job_overlord_academic_drone_desc: Specifically equipped drones who utilize resources from several empires to conduct unique experiments and research.
job_overlord_academic_effect_desc: £ Overlord Academics turn Subject [Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep] into £ £ £ Research for both Overlord and Subject.
job_overlord_academic_drone_effect_desc: £ Overlord Academics turn Subject [Root.SubjectResearcherUpkeep] into £ £ £ Research for both Overlord and Subject.
job_overlord_trader_desc: Traders who specialize in selling foreign goods at the local domestic market.
job_overlord_trader_drone_desc: A distribution drone which specializes in redistributing foreign goods among its peers for maximum efficiency.
job_overlord_trader_effect_desc: £ Overlord Traders transfer Subject £ Energy Credits to the Overlord in exchange for £ Amenities.
job_overlord_trader_drone_effect_desc: £ Distribution Drones transfers Subject £ Energy Credits to the Overlord in exchange for £ Amenities.
job_aid_worker_desc: Aid workers bring foreign knowledge and goods to improve the lives of the local population, in ways often overlooked by the domestic government.
job_aid_worker_drone_desc: Aid workers bring foreign knowledge and goods to improve the lives of the local population, in ways often overlooked by the domestic government.
job_aid_worker_effect_desc: £ Aid Workers produces £ Amenities for the Subject and £ Unity for the Overlord.
job_aid_worker_drone_effect_desc: £ Aid Workers produces £ Amenities for the Subject and £ Unity for the Overlord.
job_overlord_breeder_desc: Feeding the Offspring is a vital job to ensure stability on the planet. It's also a fairly well paid job.
job_overlord_breeder_drone_desc: Feeding the newborn drones is an important part of ensuring the young spawn can grow correctly, quickly, and effectively.
job_overlord_breeder_effect_desc:
£ Overlord Breeders turn Subject [Root.OverlordConsumes] into 2 £ Pop Assembly for Overlord capital.
An £ Overlord Spawning Complex blocker will spawn on the planet, occupying a district slot.
job_overlord_breeder_drone_effect_desc:
£ Overlord Breeders turn Subject [Root.OverlordConsumes] into 2 £ Pop Assembly for Overlord capital.
An £ Overlord Spawning Complex blocker will spawn on the planet, occupying a district slot.
job_mind_thrall_desc: The thralls come together in large groups to temporarily serve the machine network's need, renting out their minds for processing needs.
job_mind_thrall_drone_desc: The thralls come together in large groups to temporarily serve the machine network's need, renting out their minds for processing needs.
job_mind_thrall_effect_desc: £ Mind Thralls produce £ £ £ Research for Overlord.
job_mind_thrall_drone_effect_desc: £ Mind Thralls produce £ £ £ Research for Overlord.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_desc: It is a prestigious responsibility to keep the Offspring safe and comfortable, even if the role often involves merely gathering food for it.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_dron: Feeding the Offspring is a vital job to ensure stability on the planet.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_effe: £ Offspring Drone Feeder use £ Food (or £ Minerals) provide access to Offspring-Led Armies and an increase in £ [GetWorker] Pop Resource Output.
job_overlord_offspring_drone_feeder_dron: £ Offspring Drone Feeders use £ Food (or £ Minerals) provide access to Offspring-Led Armies and an increase in £ Menial Drone Output.
job_overlord_metallurgist_desc: Workers manufacture complex goods via operation of heavy machinery.
job_overlord_foundry_drone_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these units to work within high temperature alloy construction.
job_overlord_fabricator_desc: Enhanced strength and heat resistant plating allows these fabricators to work within the construction facilities.
job_overlord_catalytic_technician_desc: Highly trained workers are needed to turn raw organic matter into durable alloys necessary for advanced construction.
job_overlord_catalytic_drone_desc: Valuable organic compounds are processed into durable alloys for naval development and advanced construction by highly-specialized Catalytic Drones.
job_overlord_alloy_producer_effect_desc: [foundry.GetIcon] Overlord [Root.AlloysProducer] turn Subject £ Minerals into £ Alloys for the Overlord.
job_overlord_alloy_producer_catalytic_ef: [foundry.GetIcon] Overlord [Root.AlloysProducer] turn Subject £ Food into £ Alloys for the Overlord.
job_overlord_beholder_desc: Military overseers working with a larger network of command centers to calculate the best possible defense routes for their contractor.
job_overlord_beholder_drone_desc: Military drones working within a larger synaptic network to calculate the best possible means of defense.
job_overlord_beholder_effect_desc: £ Overlord Beholders raise the Defense Platform limit for the Overlord at the cost of Subject £ Alloys.
job_overlord_necromancer_desc: Skilled practitioners of the secrets art, from our Overlord, have shared the secrets of reanimation to a chosen few.
job_overlord_necromancer_drone_desc: Skilled practitioners of the secrets art, from our Overlord, have shared the secrets of reanimation to a chosen few.
job_overlord_necromancer_effect_desc: £ Overlord Necromancers provide the subject with Undead Defense Armies while granting the Overlord £ £ Research.
job_overlord_reassigner_desc: The Overlord has made sure that their employees will never be out of a job and have now extended that courtesy to their vassals.
job_overlord_reassigner_drone_desc: The Overlord has made sure that their employees will never be out of a job and have now extended that courtesy to their vassals.
job_overlord_reassigner_effect_desc: £ Overlord Reassigners provide the subject with £ Zombie Pops.
job_overlord_recruiter_desc: The Overlord desires for the Vassal to be able to defend themselves. That is at least what they say before they ship the fresh recruits off-world.
job_overlord_recruiter_drone_desc: The Overlord desires for the Vassal to be able to defend themselves. That is at least what they say before they ship the fresh recruits off-world.
job_overlord_recruiter_effect_desc: [soldier.GetIcon] Overlord Recruiters provide the subject with £ Defense Armies with a chance of joining our empire after their tour of duty is complete.
job_overlord_ranger_desc: Tasked with ensuring that nature is always present in some form on the planet, the Ranger is on the lookout for anything that could endanger the area sectioned off by the Overlord.
job_overlord_ranger_drone_desc: Tasked with ensuring that nature is always present in some form on the planet, the Ranger is on the lookout for anything that could endanger the area sectioned off by the Overlord.
job_overlord_ranger_effect_desc: £ Overlord Rangers provide a £ Consumer Goods Upkeep reduction while providing the Overlord with £ Unity.
job_overlord_arborist_desc: On this world, the Overlord planted a sapling from their world tree. It is our responsibility to ensure it never withers, lest we face their wrath.
job_overlord_arborist_drone_desc: On this world, the Overlord planted a sapling from their world tree. It is our responsibility to ensure it never withers, lest we face their wrath.
job_overlord_bio_trophy_desc: Worried that we might lack for anything or even be hurt, our Overlord has provided a lucky few with the opportunity to experience what they call "mandatory pampering."
job_overlord_bio_trophy_drone_desc: The drones our Overlord directed to this structure are told to "relax" and "enjoy themselves." The Overlord may not fully understand the nature of a drone, but at least the sensations are novel.
job_overlord_bio_trophy_effect_desc: £ Overlord Bio-Trophies provide a £ Happiness increase and cost no upkeep for the Subject while providing the Overlord and the Subject with £ Unity.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_desc: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, but our way forward is by accepting them. Only those who are willing will be asked to make the ultimate sacrifice.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_drone_desc: The customs of our Overlord may seem strange and mysterious, yet we are to be a part of them. A few of our drones have been designated to join what the Overlord calls 'a study of life', one which concludes with their willing sacrifice.
job_overlord_mortal_initiate_effect_desc: [mortal_initiate.GetIcon] Overlord Mortal Initiates produce £ Unity, £ Amenities and £ Research for the Subject. Overlord Mortal Initiate can be used for Sacrifices.
job_overlord_manager_desc: Middle managers that optimize the behavior of the local white-collar workers to synergize with the Overlord's long-term corporate trajectory.
job_overlord_manager_effect_desc: £ Overlord Managers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Trade for the Subject, and £ Unity for the Overlord.
policy_subjugation_war_terms_desc: Our stance regarding the initial Agreement Terms for Vassals or Subsidiaries we subjugate via war.
job_archivist_desc: Under Keides' careful guidance, these Archivists are responsible for cataloging data in accordance with Vagrosian standards.

ship_junkyard_desc: This planet is filled with old derelict ships and a fallen orbital shipyard. It makes for a great place to scavenge for precious metals as well as old technology.
origin_legendary_leader_desc: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.
origin_legendary_leader_imperial_desc: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.
origin_legendary_leader_dictatorial_desc: Amidst violence and hardship, this civilization was unified by a single leader. Consolidating power through the repression of weaker factions, they have now become a fierce advocate for science and technological advancement. In the aftermath, an uneasy peace has descended. But peace rarely lasts.
origin_legendary_leader_death_desc: Amidst political turmoil, and without the Luminary's guidance, the people must make their own way in the galaxy.
origin_legendary_leader_no_gov_change: Can't change Authority with Under One Rule Origin
origin_legendary_leader_finish_desc: The 40-year plan is vital to our empire's success. By combining our efforts under the Luminary's guidance, we will achieve things far greater than we could alone.
origin_delusional_tyrant_finish_desc: By apprehending their leaders in an empire-wide sweep, we can cripple the Reformists and force them to the negotiating table on our terms.
origin_fruitful_desc: This verdant civilization has developed a unique synergy with spaceborne fauna. By offering their fruits to these creatures, they entice the seed dispersers to aid their colonization efforts.

job_catalytic_technician_effect_desc: £ Catalytic Technicians turn £ Food into £ Alloys
job_catalytic_drone_desc: Valuable organic compounds are processed into durable alloys for naval development and advanced construction by highly-specialized Catalytic Drones.

planet_political_frontier_desc: This colony is considered fertile ground for campaigns by Factions across the political spectrum.
planet_political_safezone_desc: Political Factions are being discouraged from campaign work within this colony.
planet_political_crackdown_desc: Political Factions are actively prevented from campaigning within this colony.
planet_political_admittance_desc: This colony permits more disruptive forms of political discourse in exchange for better monitoring and sociological understanding.
policy_psionic_choir_desc: Telepaths gather to harmonize with the energies of the Shroud. Their melodies reverberate within the empire's psionic population, focusing and elevating their efforts.
policy_psionic_suppression_policy_desc: This policy controls whether or not we will dismantle devices that suppress Psionic Auras when taking control of a system.
ship_terrify_tt: Chance to ['concept_terrify'] Military Ships for £ 5-10 Days, based on Target Ship Size.
job_shroud_trader_desc: These experts attune to the emotional zeitgeist in the local markets, striking deals and hosting seminars on current trends in thought leadership.

mod_job_fe_acolyte_generator_automated_w: £ Acolytes of the Hyperspanner Automated Workforce
mod_job_fe_acolyte_mine_automated_workfo: £ Acolytes of the Hammer Automated Workforce
edict_energy_drain_desc: The population is required to have essence harvesting implants installed and inspected on a regular basis. They must be capable of being activated at a moment's notice.
edict_energy_drain_tt: Leaders will never die of old age.
edict_sanguine_council_desc: Regular fluid tests are mandated for the whole population, through which vital energy is extracted for the benefit of the empire's governing council.
edict_sanguine_council_machine_desc: Regular fluid tests are mandated for the whole population, through which vital energy is extracted for the benefit of the empire's governing council.
edict_galactic_dowsing_desc: When prospectors add divinatory practices to their conventional geological analyses, they will discover richer veins of resources.
edict_galactic_dowsing_gestalt_desc: When prospectors add divinatory practices to their conventional geological analyses, they will discover richer veins of resources.
edict_annihilation_of_matter_desc: With each scrap of dust thrown to the flame, the heat of oblivion burns ever brighter.
edict_annihilation_of_energy_desc: The dance of entropy has been spinning long before we were aware of its magnificence. We only now raise its tempo.
edict_dimensional_collapse_desc: There are dimensions other than the Shroud entwined with our own. Their power, too, will unravel with time.
edict_psychic_feast_desc: With significant mental effort, we can awaken even greater power within our leaders.
edict_animatus_desc: The Animator of Clay sparks new life within our fleets; it is as if they have wills of their own.
edict_will_of_temperance_desc: The will of the Outsider alerts us to the dangers lurking ahead.
edict_will_of_distraction_desc: The Golden Dream reveals to us ascended forms of leisure.
edict_will_of_endless_desc: The Endless Tide enhances our perspectives on time itself.
edict_will_of_rebirth_desc: The Pale Mountain makes, so that it may unmake.
edict_will_of_order_desc: The Vacant Throne knows the order of all things.
edict_will_of_motion_desc: The velocity of the Black River sweeps us along the void.
job_energy_thrall_desc: Excess energies of the population can be put to better use in sustaining quality leadership. Each Energy Thrall is implanted with a specially calibrated siphoning device which collects their essence into easy-to-transfer power cells.
job_energy_thrall_effect_desc: £ Energy Thralls produce £ Unity, £ Leader Experience Gain, and reduce Pop Growth Penalty from Energy Drain and Sanguine Council Edicts by 0.02%.
job_drone_energy_thrall_desc: Idle consciousnesses can be put to better use in sustaining quality leadership nodes. Each Energy Drone is implanted with a specially calibrated siphoning device which collects their unused energy into easy-to-transfer power cells.
job_drone_energy_thrall_effect_desc: £ Energy Drones produce £ Unity, £ Leader Experience Gain, and reduce Pop Assembly Penalty from Energy Drain and Sanguine Council Edicts by 0.02%.
job_superstitious_beliefs_priest_desc: By performing arcane rites and rituals, these adepts communicate with entities beyond ordinary perception, providing mystical insight to the masses.
job_superstitious_beliefs_priest_effect_: £ Spirit Mediums turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Stability
job_superstitious_beliefs_priest_corpora: Leveraging time-honored mystical pipelines, these brand evangelists provide commercial insights beyond the limits of conventional market projections.
£ Fortune Tellers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Trade and £ Stability
job_superstitious_beliefs_high_priest_de: With the stars as their guide, these mystical leaders guide the spiritual institutions of the empire.
job_superstitious_beliefs_high_priest_ef: £ High Astrologists turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Stability
job_superstitious_beliefs_high_priest_co: With the stars as their guide, these thought leaders coordinate the spiritual enterprises of the empire.
£ Fortune Brokers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity, £ Trade and £ Stability
job_corpse_reader_desc: By observing and interpreting each corpse's unique decomposition, the mysteries of the galaxy will be revealed to us.
job_corpse_broker_desc: The organs and bones of the deceased can fetch a good price as supplies for divination rituals.
job_test_subject_desc: Convicted of criminal activity, these individuals have been put to productive use as live test subjects in technological experiments.
job_test_subject_effect_desc: £ Test Subjects are used to produce £ £ £ Research and £ Amenities
job_test_subject_drone_desc: After straying from the will of the collective, these deviants have been put to productive use as live test subjects in technological experiments.
job_test_subject_drone_effect_desc: £ Test Subject Drones are used to produce £ £ £ Research and £ Amenities
job_experiment_engineer_desc: These elite researchers carry out experiments on live test subjects drawn from the criminal population, with no qualms about the severity of their methodologies.
job_experiment_engineer_effect_desc: £ Experiment Engineers turn £ Supplies and £ Crime into £ £ £ Research
job_experiment_engineer_drone_desc: These research drones carry out experiments on live test subjects drawn from the deviant population. No methodology is too harsh if it benefits the collective.
job_experiment_engineer_drone_effect_des: £ Experiment Engineer Drones turn £ Crime into £ £ £ Research
mod_pop_experiment_engineer_drone_bonus_: Job Efficiency for Experiment Engineer Drones
job_slave_orderly_desc: These workers are responsible for the day-to-day care of those subjected to experimental procedures that often render them unable to care for themselves.
job_slave_orderly_effect_desc: £ Orderlies increase £ [GetResearcherPlural] Output and produce £ Amenities
job_telepath_drone_desc: Operatives of the Psi Corps, a unit of psionically-advanced drones dedicated to reducing deviancy.
job_telepath_drone_effect_desc: £ Telepath Drones produce £ Unity, decrease £ Deviancy, and provide a general productivity boost on the planet.
job_production_overseer_desc: Production Overseers work to eliminate inefficiencies and maximize the outputs from complex manufacturing processes.
job_production_overseer_effect_desc: £ Production Overseers turn £ Supplies into £ Unity and £ Amenities
job_spe_colonist_desc: The creation of a new colony is hard work, with workers required to undertake many roles simultaneously.
job_spe_colonist_effect_desc: [colonist.GetIcon] [colonist.GetNamePlural] produce a small amount of £ Food (or £ Minerals) and £ Amenities, and spawn £ Defense Armies.
job_extradimensional_research_unit_desc: Dedicated research units focused on studies into the dimensions of thought.
job_purge_sacrifice_desc: The Eater craves more than conflict alone. The bodies of our enemies are fitting tribute.

WARNING: Challenging Origin
WARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.

This civilization has been long-obsessed with a mysterious calamity which turned a neighboring planet into a desolate and shrouded world. Now, as they take to the stars, they can finally explore its secrets and find out if a similar fate awaits them too.

edict_will_to_power_desc: As power is simply the ability to impose one's will on others, the will to power is a self-fulfilling prophecy.
origin_toxic_knights_desc: Centuries ago, this species' homeworld was visited by a Toxic Entity. The ecological catastrophe that followed ruined half the world, but allowed an early unification of the survivors in their reverence for the Toxic God. An Order of Knights has been created to search for the Toxic God, and although many things have changed, the quest continues.

job_knight_desc: Trained for combat; well educated; virtuous. These knights represent the very best of our society, and they have dedicated their lives to the search for the Toxic God.
job_knight_effect_desc:
[knight.GetIcon] [knight.GetNamePlural] turn £ Alloys into £ Unity and £ £ £ Research, increase £ Naval Capacity and spawn £ Defense Armies
Completing Knightly Quests can further improve their output.

job_squire_effect_desc: [squire.GetIcon] [squire.GetNamePlural] provide £ Amenities and increase Job Efficiency of [knight.GetIcon] [knight.GetNamePlural].
job_knight_commander_desc: The knights are worthy and honorable - the best our society has to offer. But even they need leadership. Where the Lord Commander leads, there shall the knights follow.

£ Lord Commanders turn £ Alloys into £ Unity and £ Amenities, and increase £ Naval Capacity.

policy_knightly_duties_desc: Our Knights are the elite of what our country has to offer. Loyal, devoted, honorable, they are paragons of chivalry, and if we are ready to divert them from the Quest, their many skills could be invaluable as we find our place in the galaxy.
job_overlord_knight_commandery_effect_de: [knight.GetIcon] Overlord [knight.GetNamePlural] turn £ Alloys into £ Stability and spawn £ Defense Armies for the Subject, and £ Unity and £ £ £ Research Points for the Overlord.

origin_overtuned_desc: This civilization uses any and all means of organic enhancement, no matter the risk, no matter the cost. After all, it is better to burn out brightly than fade away into obscurity.
origin_overtuned_effects: Starts with advanced biological traits available, which are stronger and cheaper than normal traits but carry extraordinary risks.

job_bath_attendant_desc: Trained Attendants for the Mutagenic Spas. Their purpose in life is to ensure their clients' continued health through a variety of services, including intemperate detoxification and carefully curated genotype degeneration.
job_toxic_baths_effect_hive_desc: £ Permutation Attendance Drones increase £ Biological Pop Assembly but reduce £ Habitability.
job_bath_attendant_hive_desc: Specialized Drones, grown for the sole purpose of overseeing the Permutation Process during the creation of new biological drones for the hive.

job_bath_attendant_machine_desc: Lubrication Terminals are specially programmed drones, overseeing the submerged production of new shells, carefully monitoring the lubricant conditions during the process.

policy_relentless_industrialists_policy_: To live is to exploit. But to exploit to the degree that we practice it has consequences. We can choose to channel our energies towards the attainment of more, or seek to mitigate its worst effects.
edict_damn_the_consequences_desc:
This Edict pushes our genetic modifications to the very limit, doubling their effect but also causing an increased amount of terrible side-effects, including sudden catastrophic combustion.

Damn the Consequences ignores ['concept_edict_fund'] and will always use 80% of your monthly £ Unity income!
edict_damn_the_consequences_effects: All positive effects from Overtuned Traits are doubled.

origin_wilderness_desc:
WARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths except for ['concept_purity_ascension'].

This entity is nothing less than a sapient ecosphere: a multitude of diverse lifeforms which long since coalesced to form a gestalt consciousness on a planetary scale.

country_virtual_jobs: All jobs worked within this Empire are automatically filled.
pop_cat_wilderness_heart_strata_desc: The combined will of an entire ecosphere, expressed as though it were one mind.
job_pollinosymbiont_desc: Tasked with planetary fertility, they pollinate not only flowers, but by forests, meadows, and reefs alike.
job_photosymbiont_desc: Visible from orbit, the migratory rhythms of these symbionts are synchronized with the arc of the sun.
job_grubsymbiont_desc: Sightless and soft-bodied, these symbionts burrow by vibration, drawn only to the resonance of precious metal.
job_choirsymbiont_desc: These symbionts emit layered, melodic calls that ripple through the biosphere. An intricate, living music that guides and uplifts the whole.
job_choirsymbiont_effect_desc: £ Choirsymbionts turn £ Energy Credits and £ Food (or £ Minerals) into £ Unity
job_forgesymbiont_desc: Born of magma and guided by instinct, these symbionts refine raw ores into alloyed forms, bearing them upward like offerings to the Wilderness.
job_evosymbiont_physicist_desc: These symbionts' bodies are living hypotheses. Bristling with novel antennae, refractive membranes, and lattice-like spines, they evolved to taste gravity and decode chemical formulas.
job_evosymbiont_biologist_desc: These symbionts' bodies are living hypotheses. Bristling with novel antennae, refractive membranes, and lattice-like spines, they evolved to taste gravity and decode chemical formulas.
job_evosymbiont_engineer_desc: These symbionts' bodies are living hypotheses. Bristling with novel antennae, refractive membranes, and lattice-like spines, they evolved to taste gravity and decode chemical formulas.
job_evosymbiont_desc: These symbionts' bodies are living hypotheses. Bristling with novel antennae, refractive membranes, and lattice-like spines, they evolved to taste gravity and decode chemical formulas.
job_evosymbiont_effect_desc: £ Evosymbionts turn £ Minerals into £ Physics Research £ Society Research £ Engineering Research
job_evosymbiont_physicist_effect_desc: £ Physics Evosymbionts turn £ Minerals into £ Physics Research
job_evosymbiont_biologist_effect_desc: £ Biology Evosymbionts turn £ Minerals into £ Society Research
job_evosymbiont_engineer_effect_desc: £ Engineering Evosymbionts turn £ Minerals into £ Engineering Research
job_tamersymbiont_desc: These symbionts emit complex pheromonal signals to guide the Presapient Horde, turning wild instinct into coordinated planetary defense.
job_tamersymbiont_effect_desc: [soldier.GetIcon] Tamersymbionts increase £ Naval Capacity, £ Stability, and spawn £ Defense Armies
job_immunosymbiont_desc: These symbionts detect deviancy and disrupt dissent, patrolling the wilderness roots, macro-sized antibodies for a macro-sized organism.
job_immunosymbiont_effect_desc: [patrol_drone.GetIcon] Immunosymbionts decrease £ Deviancy, spawn £ Defense Armies, and produce £ Unity
job_broodsymbiont_desc: These symbionts saturate the Wilderness with pliable biomass: raw, living matter poised for transformation into whatever the planet may require.
job_broodsymbiont_effect_desc: [spawning_drone.GetIcon] Broodsymbionts turn £ Food (or £ Minerals) into £ Amenities and £ Biomass
job_motesymbiote_desc: Living on the edge of combustion, these symbionts birth flickering motes of unstable power. Small, bright, and deadly.
job_crystalsymbiote_desc: These symbionts cultivate rare crystal formations across their bodies. Each growth is shaped by environment, function, and collective need.
job_gaseosymbiote_desc: Masters of microbial alchemy, these symbionts maintain the precise conditions needed to naturally generate exotic gasses.
job_spindlesymbiont_desc: With countless flexible limbs and exotic sensory organs, this symbiont directs the flow of resources, routing nutrients, matter, and material where it is needed most. Every motion balances the Wilderness.
job_wilderness_maintenance_drone_desc: Biomass brimming with potential, stored and maintained until it is needed.
job_heart_processing_desc: This biomass will soon be integrated. It is destined to serve a higher function within ourselves.
job_neurosymbiont_desc: Living conduits between the Behemoth and us, these symbionts' lives are spent drip feeding our psyche into the beast's.
policy_symbiont_policy_desc: Our mutualistic collective is eminently capable and productive, but it is not limitless. We must decide how and where our resources are put to best use.
edict_capacity_subsidies_wilderness_desc: This Edict encourages our photosynthetic symbionts to form migratory herds that follow the sun across our surface, increasing energy output.
edict_mining_subsidies_wilderness_desc: This Edict reinforces our roots, allowing our burrowing symbionts to dig with less risk of structural collapse.
edict_farming_subsidies_wilderness_desc: This Edict provides aggressive dilution of high energy chemicals in our soil to boost our nutrition output.
edict_forge_subsidies_wilderness_desc: Saturating our lithotrophic algae pools with nutrients allows for seasonal blooms and increased harvest of alloy byproducts.
edict_research_subsidies_wilderness_desc: Knowledge is power. This Edict focuses our efforts on advancing technology.
edict_clearing_motes_wilderness_desc: Supplementing symbiont diets with volatile motes allows for digestion of both organic and inorganic substances. Our holobiont will adapt our own environment by eating it.
edict_learning_campaign_wilderness_desc: By providing our symbionts with additional nutrients, we are able to increase productivity.
edict_war_drone_campaign_wilderness_desc: By allocating additional nutrients to our predator and herd symbionts, we are able to increase their strength and combat readiness.
edict_scientific_revolution_wilderness_d: A brief yet highly productive golden age of scientific discovery. The combination of fearlessness, ingenuity and unbridled optimism can take you far.
edict_drone_overdrive_wilderness_desc: Our biomes will be made more competitive, as more resources are required.
anomaly_failure.1.desc_STH: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] ordered the [Root.GetName] to dispatch a probe to investigate the moon [From.From.GetName]. Unfortunately, its braking thrusters failed, and the probe proceeded to smash into the world at full impulse.
anomaly_failure.400.desc_STH:
For unclear reasons, the resident Science Officer decided to take out a shuttle from the [Root.GetName] to personally investigate the moon [From.From.GetName]. An explosion was detected shortly afterwards when the shuttle impacted the surface at full impulse.

A review of redundant log files verified that the drone had several miscalculations due to a flaw in its cortical implant. We have initiated an update to all further implants.
ship_out_of_time_1.desc:
The chroniton pulses observed from orbit have been localised to a single source, several kilometres below the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. 

After several days of analysis, scientists from the [Root.GetName] have been able to partially scan through the distortion bubble around the source of the chronitons and have detected what appears to be a [Root.Owner.GetName] vessel surrounded by rock.
ship_out_of_time_1.name: Chroniton Pulses
