TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_2A_DESC:
Sub-Impulse Thruster 
A new type of thruster that builds upon the operating principles of fusion thrusters. Combines plasma from a fusion reactor with high energy plasma from the warp core.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_2B_DESC:
Stealth Thruster 
A thruster system designed with stealth as the primary concern. To this end, the high temperature plasma generated by the fusion reactor is cooled, before being highly pressurised and then expelled.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3A_DESC:
Impulse Thruster 
Impulse thrusters boosted by creating an anti-gravity wake behind the vessel to push it forward. Limitations in gravity manipulation technology mean that the wake is prone to turbulence issues.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3B_DESC:
Paralithium Mk. III Stealth Thruster 
A cold thruster which combines older impulse technology with even older ion engine theories. It is fueled by paralithium, an isotope of lithium which is now widely available thanks to advanced, new synthesis techniques.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_3B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Paralithium Mk. III Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4A_DESC:
Avidyne Thruster 
New type of impulse thruster, which eschews the unreliable anti-gravity wake. Instead, engine efficiency is increased by pulsing the plasma exhaust, creating controlled energetic turbulence patterns.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4B_DESC:
RCS Mk. IV Stealth Thruster 
Cold thrust impulse engine complimented by a reaction control system fueled by lower temperature plasma than previous models.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_4B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: RCS Mk. IV Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_5A_DESC:
Impulse Manifold 
Impulse engine comprised of a fifth generation or higher Avidyne thruster, fitted with a specialised impulse exhaust manifold.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_5B_DESC:
Cooled Mk. V Stealth Thruster 
Stealth impulse thruster augmented with cooled impulse capacitor banks. The capacitor banks store cold drive plasma, primarily for use in combat situations.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_5B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Cooled Mk. V Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6A_DESC:
Impulse Manifold Mk. VI 
An important milestone in impulse engine technology, this engine is powered solely by high-energy plasma from the warp core; no fusion-produced plasma is required.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Impulse Manifold Mk. VI
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6B_DESC:
Masked Mk. VI Stealth Thruster 
Stealth thruster system with major improvements. The exhaust manifold has been replaced by an electro-thermal signature masking, multi-vector thruster array.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_6B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Masked Mk. VI Stealth Thruster
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_7A_DESC:
Compound Impulse Manifold Mk. VII 
Building on the success of the Shange shunts and the new compound impulse assembly, impulse engine engineers have created a radical new exhaust manifold, featuring an array of high pressure, multi-vector, exhaust ports.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_7A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Compound Impulse Manifold Mk. VII
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_7B_DESC:
Paragravitic Drive 
Highly advanced graviton flow dynamics simulation processors have been combined with modern graviton emitters. The result is an impulse engine add-on which uses an 'anti-gravity wake' to push the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_8A_DESC:
Hyper-Impulse Engine 
A revolution in impulse engine design, the hyper-impulse drive engine uses warp-grade plasma fed from dedicated miniature matter-antimatter reactors.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_8B_DESC:
Subspace-Shifted Mk. VIII Stealth Thruster 
An incredibly sophisticated stealth engine that uses modified graviton emitters. The gravimetric disturbances that form the 'anti-gravity wake' have been made to catch the expelled plasma as it leaves the impulse manifold and shift it into subspace.
TECH_UNLOCK_THRUSTER_8B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Subspace-Shifted Mk. VIII Stealth Thruster

TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_1_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit 
Graviton coils create micro singularities to weaken the normal-space/subspace barrier in front of the vessel. Repositioned warp coils create a dense subspace bubble than normal, forcing the vessel through the weakened region of space, into transwarp space.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_2_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit II 
This transwarp coil functions as a gravimetric lens, generating and converting a large force into a subspace distortion. The distortion will allow direct access to transwarp space, maintaining the distortion will allow travel through it.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_3_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit III 
This transwarp coil has been augmented with the ability to generate triaxilating tetryons. The triaxilating tetryons amplify energetic oscillations in the subspace interfold layers, causing distortions to form.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_4_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit IV 
This transwarp coil has been adjusted to allow easier access to our artificial transwarp conduits. Generated and maintained by transwarp node facilities, these artificial conduits are better optimised for the needs of our vessels than naturally occurring conduits.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_5_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit V 
The artificial transwarp conduits have been remodulated to reduce the gravimetric distortion gradient over their cross section. As this generates less resistive force, a higher velocity is attainable.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_6_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit VI 
New transwarp coils are specialised to provide maximum speed and efficiency within natural transwarp conduits, at the expense of being able to enter the remaining few natural, unassimilated conduits.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_7_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit VII 
This transwarp coil is able to automatically link to the interspatial manifolds ahead of the vessel, giving them details about the ship and alter the conduit to optimise it for the vessel's parameters.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_8_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit VIII 
The interspatial manifold network is now responsible for maintaining the transwarp conduits and autonomously growing the network. This transwarp coil is able to automatically link to the interspatial manifolds ahead of the vessel, giving them details about the ship. The manifolds then temporarily alter the conduit to optimise it for the vessel's parameters.
TECH_UNLOCK_TRANSWARP_ENGINE_9_DESC:
Transwarp Conduit IX 
The interspatial manifold network is now responsible for maintaining the transwarp conduits and autonomously growing the network. This transwarp coil is able to automatically link to the interspatial manifolds ahead of the vessel, giving them details about the ship.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_FACTORY_2_DESC:
Biomass Mega-Forges 
Improved Biomass production sites, give greater benefit to the Undine conquest.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_HATCHERY_1_DESC:
Undine Hatchery 
Unlocks the specialised spawning hatchery which increases the growth rate of the Undine.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_HATCHERY_2_DESC:
Improved Hatchery 
Unlocks the improved spawning hatchery which increases the growth rate of the Undine.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_HATCHERY_3_DESC:
Advanced Hatchery 
Unlocks the advanced spawning hatchery which increases the growth rate of the Undine.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_REACTOR_1_DESC:
Fluidic Generator 
Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_REACTOR_2_DESC:
Fluidic Amplification Reactor 
Specially applied concentrated bursts of nuclear energy against bio-matter generates powerful reactions that can be harvested for energy production. This energy is then amplified using the psychic power of the Undine mind.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_REACTOR_3_DESC:
Fluidic Bio Reactor 
Specially mixed concentrations of fluidic matter and bio-matter generates powerful waves of energy that can be used to power Undine Technology.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_REACTOR_PK_DESC:
Psi Projection Generator 
Mass detonation of biomass is harnessed by the powerful minds of Undine engineers and directed towards powering their most powerful vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_SHIELD_1_DESC:
Psi Energy Field I 
A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creating a powerful defensive field.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_SHIELD_1_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Psi Energy Field I
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_SHIELD_2_DESC:
Psi Energy Field II 
A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creating a powerful defensive field.

TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_SHIELD_DESC:
Psi Energy Field 
A field generated from the Undine pilot's mental strength channeled through the living ship creating a powerful defensive field.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_1_DESC:
Bio Propulsion Unit 
A network of impulse exhaust thrusters that are built from the vessel's hull, allowing movement in any direction without having to turn. Creating natural pulse waves to propel the vessel forward.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_2_DESC:
Bio Propulsion Array 
A larger-scale version of the bio propulsion unit impulse drive. Increased quantities of plasma generator nodes, combined with arrays of exhaust nodes, give this engine superior speed and manoeuvrability over the original design.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_3_DESC:
Bio Propulsion Impulse Array 
Improved specification Bio Propulsion Impulse Array. The primary enhancement is the fitting of a high-gain impulse exhaust array. The increased efficiency boosts the vessel's acceleration, increasing manoeuvrability and cruising speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Bio Propulsion Impulse Array
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_4_DESC:
Bio Propulsion Impulse Manifold 
The Bio Propulsion Impulse Manifold impulse thruster array enhanced with a new reactant, avidyne. Plasma fusion nodes use avidyne to produce hotter, denser plasma exhaust, efficiently increasing the vessel's speed.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Bio Propulsion Impulse Manifold
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_5_DESC:
Bio Propulsion Directional Array 
Avidyne-based Bio Propulsion Directional Array enhanced with an avidyne-compatible thruster manifold. The heavy plasma turbulence problems which reduced the efficiency of the original design have been fixed, improving performance characteristics.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Bio Propulsion Directional Array
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_6_DESC:
Bio Propulsion High-Gain Impulse Array 
A Bio Propulsion High-Gain Impulse Array is an immensely powerful artificial graviton cores project a strong, localised, gravimetric tunnel. The tunnel pulls the vessel through it, accelerating it in the direction of travel.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Bio Propulsion High-Gain Impulse Array
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_7_DESC:
Bio Propulsion Compound Array 
Built from miniaturised assembly segments to form a flexible, compound impulse assembly, this Bio Propulsion Compound Array provides omni-directional thrust.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_7_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Bio Propulsion Compound Array
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_8_DESC:
Bio Propulsion Hyper-Impulse Array 
Dedicated matter-antimatter reactors power the omni-directional impulse field. These small reactors will feed the impulse engines with warp plasma, usually reserved for energising the warp coils.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNDINE_THRUSTER_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Bio Propulsion Hyper-Impulse Array
TECH_UNLOCK_UNITY_ENERGY_DISTRICT_DESC:
Unity 
Commercial districts now produce +1 free units of £ Unity per district.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNITY_MILITARY_DISTRICT_DESC:
Unity 
Administrative districts now produce more £ Unity.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNLOCKS_ARMIES_DESC:
Defensive Armies 
Planetary wide governments require the infrastructure for military forces to be able to deploy to fend off invaders from the stars.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNLOCKS_ARMY_TRANSPORTS_DESC:
Transports 
Landing troops on another world requires new technologies in order to rapidly and effectively shift massive armies and all their equipment from place to place.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNLOCKS_CROSSBREEDING_DESC:
Cross-Breeding 
Cross-breeding two alien genomes together to form a new species - half one species, half another - is now possible.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNLOCKS_ICONIAN_GATEWAY_DESC:
Iconian Gateway 
Repairing the Iconian Gateway controls in order to use the ancient technology will increase our ability to send supplies across the galaxy.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNLOCKS_OMEGA_FACILITY_DESC:
Omega Facility 
Upgrades to the Polaric Ion Power Generators allows the facility to harness the dangerous power of the Omega molecule, which can produce massive amounts of energy.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNLOCKS_UNICOMPLEX_EXPANSION:
Unicomplex Expansion 
Each section of the unicomplex can be expanded via decision.
TECH_UNLOCK_UNLOCK_SPEC_MECHANICS_DESC:
Planet Specialisation 
Dedicating an entire world to one specialisation is the dream of economists across the galaxy. Which path will you take?
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_1_DESC:
Basic Warp Engine 
The initial warp engine creates a stable warp field in the matter antimatter chamber, known as a warp core.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_2_DESC:
Yoyodyne Pulse Fusion Warp Engine 
The Yoyodyne warp drive allows faster warp speeds by utilising a matter antimatter intermix chamber, thus creating a more stable warp field.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Yoyodyne Pulse Fusion Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_3_DESC:
Gravimetric Manifold Warp Engine 
Through the use of specialised and improved plasma conduits, our cores can efficiently provide the Warp plasma needed to create vastly more stable subspace fields.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Gravimetric Manifold Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_4A_DESC:
Main-Stage Type-2 Exploration Warp Engine 
The main-stage warp engine creates a powerful and stable warp field that increases the speed of our vessels, and allows them to travel greater distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_4A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Main-Stage Type-2 Exploration Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_4B_DESC:
Battle-ready Combat Warp Engine 
A plasma coolant system that is situated adjacent to the anti-matter/matter intermix chamber allows for a more efficient power-transfer.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_4B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Battle-ready Combat Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_5A_DESC:
Cyclic Type-5 Warp Engine 
By cycling the warp engine constantly, we generate a high-frequency warp field which increases the efficiency of our warp engines and allows ships to travel greater distances.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_5A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Cyclic Type-5 Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_5B_DESC:
Polarized Combat Warp Engine 
By installing an array of conduit branches, we are able to better improve the feed of a warp plasma manifold.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_5B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Polarized Combat Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_6A_DESC:
Dicyclic Type-7 Warp Engine 
The warp field rotation, produced by it's dicyclic warp coil configuration, is built for speed and an increase in our warp range.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_6A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Dicyclic Type-7 Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_6B_DESC:
Theta-Class Combat Warp Engine 
These warp engines recurve the flow of plasma to the injectors which make them able to perform better.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_6B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Theta-Class Combat Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_7A_DESC:
Tricyclic Type-9 Warp Engine 
A Modified Engine that uses tricyclic materials in the input manifold.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_7A_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Tricyclic Type-9 Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_7B_DESC:
Bi-Polar Combat Warp Engine 
Installing an array of conduit branches allows us to improve the feed of a warp plasma manifold. These advanced Combat Warp Engines see an increase in warp speed and recharge times; but, more importantly, a slight increase in warp range as well.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_7B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Bi-Polar Combat Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_8A_DESC:
Isodynamic Warp Engine 
A modified class-9 warp drive, capable of extended, long-term operation.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_8B_DESC:
Hyper-Injection Combat Warp Engine 
This Combat Warp Engine recurves the flow of plasma to the injectors, making it able to perform better, resulting in increased warp speed and charge times, but only a slight increase in warp range.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_8B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Hyper-Injection Combat Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_9A_DESC:
Coaxial Warp Engine 
A modified class-X warp drive, capable of extended, long-term operation.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_9B_DESC:
Coaxial Combat Warp Engine 
This Combat Warp Engine further refines the flow of plasma to the injectors making improvements on the previous models by making use of faster computer cores, making it able to perform better, resulting in increased warp speed and charge times, but only a slight increase in warp range.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_9B_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Coaxial Combat Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_1_DESC:
Coleoperic Warp Engine 
The Coleopteric Warp Engine utilises a ring-like outboard coil manifold rather than common linear warp nacelles.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_2_DESC:
Advanced Mk. II Coleopteric Warp Engine 
Advancements in Coleopteric theory allow us to create better warp engines.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Advanced Mk. II Coleopteric Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_3_DESC:
Superior Mk. III Coleopteric Warp Engine 
The apex of single ring coleopteric theory allow us to create superior warp engines.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Superior Mk. III Coleopteric Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_4_DESC:
Interlocking Mk. IV Coleopteric Warp Engine 
Utilising non linear mathematical theory we have unlocked the secrets to utilising more than one ring coil manifold at once.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Interlocking Mk. IV Coleopteric Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_5_DESC:
Triple-Ring Mk. V Coleopteric Warp Engine 
The logical progression from two interlocking ring manifolds was to introduce a third stabilizing ring which should allow the construction of even faster vessels.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Triple-Ring Mk. V Coleopteric Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_6_DESC:
Dynamic Arc Mk. VI Coleopteric Warp Engine 
Logic dictates that if arcs of different sizes can be arranged across the hull then it should theoretically be possible to construct ships with numerous rings allowing rapid warp travel.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Dynamic Arc Mk. VI Coleopteric Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_7_DESC:
Multi-Ring Mk. VII Coleopteric Warp Engine 
To counter the variables of rapid warp travel navigation, the mathematics states that should a coleopteric ring be able to pivot whilst rotating it will enable more manouverability within the coleopteric field itself, resulting in an overall increase to warp speeds.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_7_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Multi-Ring Mk. VII Coleopteric Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_8_DESC:
Multi-Ring Mk. VIII Coleopteric Warp Engine 
Theory has advanced to the point where theoretically infinite rings could be used to create a warp field, and thus if required we can sheath our coil manifolds beneath the hull until it is time to warp. This is the pinnacle of Coleopterics warp theory.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_RING_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Multi-Ring Mk. VIII Coleopteric Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_1_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core 
An engine capable of storing the most energy out all tiers of this type of warp engine.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_2_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core II 
An engine that creates field of antiprotons and neutrons, which will allow for longer singularity pulses.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core II
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_3_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core III 
By installing advanced particles and radiation sensors in the quantum singularity containment field, the quantum warp core is able to compensate for the many graviton and chroniton bursts.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core III
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_4_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core IV 
This new type of quantum engine, introduces chroniton and graviton emissions into the singularity core.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core IV
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_5_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core V 
Manipulating the emissions inside the singularity core to enable peak efficiency produces the best balance in warp speed, travel, and charge times, when compared to previous singularity iterations.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core V
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_6_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core VI 
By shifting the singularity partly into another dimension, we can manipulate the core to the extreme without worrying about radiation or accidental discharge.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core VI
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_7_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core VII 
Each singularity shift results in more rapid travel between two points as subspace is condensed. By rotating frequencies off the bands between subspace, we can direct energy from different dimensions, improving our ship speeds.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_7_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core VII
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_8_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core VIII 
Each band of singularity shifting has resulted in more rapid travel between two points as subspace is condensed into narrower and narrower bands. By finally cracking the lower subspace dimensions, we can reach the fastest speeds possible by singularity drives.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core VIII
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_9_DESC:
Artificial Singularity Core IX 
Each band of singularity shifting has resulted in more rapid travel between two points as subspace is condensed into narrower and narrower bands. By adding a Gravimetric Flux into the singularity our ability to travel at higher warp speeds is possible.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_ROM_9_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Artificial Singularity Core IX
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_SLIPSTREAM_DESC:
Slipstream Engine 
An experimental engine designed to take advantage of the quantum slipstream effect.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_SPEC_DESC:
Next-Stage Warp Engine 
This tech allows you to choose between two specialisation paths and obtain your next-stage warp engine.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_SPORE_2_DESC:
Super-Mycelial Reactor 
The super-mycelial reactor pulls energy directly out of the mycelial network. The reactor core, a large central 'energy orb' containing mycelial spores packed together, blocks the flow of the network as to harness exotic energy.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_SPORE_ADV_DESC:
Improved Spore Drive 
The displacement-activated spore hub drive has been improved by the implementation of a containment system for the mycelial spores, resulting in a lower chance of critical failure whilst jumping.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_SPORE_DESC:
Spore Drive 
The displacement-activated spore hub drive, commonly shortened to spore drive or s-drive, is an organic propulsion system that uses mycelium spores to jump or leap across the mycelial network.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_TRANSWARP_DESC:
Transwarp Engine 
Transwarp drives tunnel through space instead of move through it. Unlike traditional warp drives, a type of artificial wormhole is created which the starship can travel through.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_1_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine 
Breaching the barrier into the cold dimension of non fluidic space requires quantum singularities to be utilised to power a bio warp drive, propelling vessels throughout this dark wasteland.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_2_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine II 
The quantum singularities onboard the bioships can now reach into subspace within non fluidic space, allowing for a much larger energy source for propulsion.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_2_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine II
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_3_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine III 
The singularities onboard the bioships can now touch the fluidic dimensions from whence they came, allowing for faster travel across the dark non fluidic wastelands.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_3_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine III
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_4_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine IV 
Drawing power directly from fluidic space, the singularities propel the bioships faster through the cosmos.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_4_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine IV
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_5_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine V 
Shunting large pockets of fluidic space through into this realm through trans dimensional rifts allows for direct access to power from fluidic space. This allows rapid propulsion across the cosmos.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_5_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine V
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_6_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine VI 
Adapted bioships can now rapidly shunt fluidic space through the propulsion systems, achieving higher speeds than ever before.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_6_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine VI
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_7_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine VII 
The living hulls of the bioships redesign themselves to shunt fluidic space through the interdimensional rifts into this space, boosting energy levels and allowing for rapid propulsion.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_7_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine VII
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_8_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine VIII 
The living hulls of the bioships have evolved to radically redesign themselves to propel fluidic space through the interdimensional rifts into this space, boosting energy levels and allowing for rapid propulsion.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_8_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine VIII
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_9_DESC:
Undine Jump Engine IX 
The pinnacle of fluidic space propulsion actually transfers part of the bioship across dimensions, drawing in power from fluidic space and then oscillating back into this universe and releasing that energy, providing the quickest warp speeds.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_ENGINE_UNDINE_9_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Undine Jump Engine IX
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_KRENIM_9_DESC:
Chroniton Displacement Drive 
Chroniton Drive allows a vessel to travel great distances and remain outside of the time stream.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_XINDI_1_DESC:
Subspace Vortex Warp Engine 
A specially designed warp matrix capable of opening up a subspace vortex allowing the traversal of multiple light years in a single bound.
TECH_UNLOCK_WARP_XINDI_1_TITLE: Unlocks Component: Subspace Vortex Warp Engine
TECH_UNLOCK_WATER_BRIZEEN_FARM_DISTRICT_:
Farming 
Farming districts now produce more Water-ice and Brizeen-nitrate.
TECH_UNLOCK_XINDI_PLANET_KILLER_DESC:
Xindi 
The combined minds of all Xindi species have developed the ultimate weapon of planetary destruction.
TECH_UNLOCK_XINDI_PLANET_KILLER_WEAPON_D:
Xindi Kemocite Overload Beam 
Unlock the deadly Xindi planet destroying weapon.
TECH_UNLOCK_XINDI_PLANET_KILLER_WEAPON_T: Unlocks Component: Xindi Kemocite Overload Beam
